Lest my enemy say that he has prevailed over me, / Lest adversaries rejoice when I fall, filled with glee.
But I trust in Your loving-kindness this day, / My heart rejoices in Your salvation today.
I will sing to Yahweh, my voice raised in song, / For He has been good unto me, all along.
The fool says in his own heart that “There is no God” / They’re corrupt; their deeds are abominable and flawed
Yahweh looked down from heaven upon humankind / To see if any understood, who sought God among them
All have turned aside, together gone astray / No one does good—not one; they’re corrupt in every way
Do evil workers know nothing? They eat my people like bread / And they do not call on Yahweh; his name goes unsaid
There they were in great fear, for God is with the righteous here / For God is in the generation of the righteous
You frustrate the poor man’s plan, because Yahweh is his refuge / His shelter close at hand; Yahweh is his refuge
Oh, that Israel’s salvation would come out of Zion / When Yahweh restores their fortunes, Jacob and Israel rejoice
Yahweh, who may dwell within Your sanctuary’s hall? / Who shall live upon Your holy hill, and dwell there at all?
He walks in blameless ways and does what’s right / He speaks the truth within his heart, sincere and upright
He does no evil to a friend, nor slanders with his tongue / He casts no slur against his fellow, none against him are flung
Those who fear Yahweh he honors; vile men he despises / He keeps an oath though hurt comes; he never revises
No usury loans, no bribe against the innocent / Who does these things shall never be shaken, unbent
Preserve me, God; in you I take refuge, I cling / You are my Lord; apart from you, I have no good thing
The excellent saints who are on earth are all my delight / Their sorrows multiply; no blood libations, nor names I cite
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup; my lot stands secure / Pleasant lines have come to me; a good inheritance is sure
I bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel outright / My heart instructs me in the night seasons, by night
I set Yahweh always before me; he’s at my right hand / Because he’s there, I shall not be moved; firm I stand
Therefore my heart is glad; my tongue rejoices, for sure / My body shall also dwell in safety, secure
You will not leave my own soul in Sheol’s deep pit / Nor let your holy one see corruption’s grip
You will show me life’s path; in your presence joy’s complete / At your right hand are pleasures forever, no years can destroy
Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; let my case be judged aright / No deceit comes from my lips in prayer; Your eyes discern what’s right
At night You tried my heart; no hidden wrong came through / I set my mouth: no word of mine will disobey You
By Your word, I kept myself from violent ways / My steps held fast to Your own paths; my feet did not stray
I call; You answer, God; turn Your ear and hear my prayer / Show wondrous love; Your right hand saves those who take refuge there
Keep me as the apple of Your eye when enemies press close / Hide me beneath the shadow of Your wings, shield me from foes
Their callous hearts are shut, and their proud mouths do ring / He’s like young lion, greedy for prey, poised to spring
Rise, cast down; save me by sword and hand from men whose lot’s life alone / You fill Your own; Your sons have plenty, store wealth for children of their own
As for me, Your face in righteousness I’ll see / When I awake, Your form will satisfy me
I love you, Yahweh, my strength, my refuge, my tower / My rock, my fortress, my shield, my deliverer and power
I call Yahweh, worthy of praise, when my foes arise / He saves me from my enemies; I escape alive
Death’s cords and Sheol’s cords, death’s snares close round me tight / The ungodly floods made me afraid with fright
In distress I called to Yahweh, cried out in prayer / He heard my voice from his temple; my cry reached his ears
The earth shakes, mountain foundations quake at his rage / The mountains’ roots tremble as his wrath takes shape
Smoke pours from his nostrils; consuming flames blaze / Fire bursts from his mouth, kindling coals in its wake
He bends the heavens and comes down through the sky / He rides a cherub, on the wind he soars high
Darkness was his hiding place; thick clouds concealed / At his brightness clouds passed; hail and coals were revealed
Yahweh thunders, sends arrows and lightning in flight / His foes scatter; hailstones and coals strike with might
From on high he reaches and draws me from the deep / He pulls me from many waters, my life to keep
My foes were too mighty, too strong to withstand / Yahweh upheld me, secured by his hand
He brings me also to a broad place, spacious and wide / He delivers me, because in me he takes delight
Yahweh rewards my clean hands; I’ve kept his ways / I have not departed from him through my days
With merciful, he shows mercy; with crooked, shrewdly too / He saves the afflicted; brings arrogant eyes down low
Yahweh lights my darkness; my path is made bright / With God I cross through troops and leap walls outright
God’s way is perfect; his tested word is sure / He shields all who take refuge, keeps them secure
Yahweh makes my feet like a deer’s, fleet and strong / He trains my hands for war; my arms bend bows of bronze
His saving shield sustains me; his gentleness makes me great / He widens my steps beneath me; my footing stays straight
He arms me for battle, subdues those who rise / They cry, no savior; I scatter them like dust that flies
Yahweh makes me head of nations, raised to command / Foreigners hear my voice and submit across the land
Yahweh lives, my rock be praised; he rescues his king / Forever, loving-kindness to David and his offspring he’ll bring
The heavens declare God’s glory across the sky / His expanse displays his handiwork on high
Day after day they speak; by night, show knowledge to all / No speech or language misses; earth’s ends hear their call
God tents the sun; the bridegroom leaves his room to race / A strong runner spans the heavens; its heat reaches every place
Yahweh’s perfect law restores soul; sure pact makes simple wise / His right precepts bring hearts joy; pure commands enlighten eyes
Yahweh’s fear stays clean forever, never growing old / His true, righteous laws are sweeter than honey, prized as gold
Moreover, your servant is warned by their decree / In keeping them, a great reward there will be
Who can discern his errors? Forgive my faults hidden within / Keep proud sins from ruling me; upright, blameless, free of great sin
Let my mouth’s words, my heart’s thoughts, be acceptable in your sight / Yahweh, my rock and redeemer, may both please you aright
In the day of trouble, may Yahweh answer you / May the name of Jacob’s God set you up on high
Send help from the sanctuary; from Zion give aid / Remember offerings; accept burnt sacrifice made
May he grant your heart’s desire, make each wish come true / May he fulfill all your counsel, bring your plans through
We will triumph in your salvation, our banners displayed / In the name of our God, may Yahweh grant all you’ve prayed
Now I know Yahweh saves his anointed outright / He answers from his holy heaven by his right hand’s might
Some trust in chariots, some in horses; they put their trust there / But we trust in the name of Yahweh our God, we declare
They are bowed down and fallen, brought low to the ground / We rise up and stand upright, our feet on the ground
Save us, Yahweh; hear us when we call to thee / Let the King answer us when we call to thee
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh, with delight / Your salvation fills his heart with joy, his gladness bright
You granted heart’s desire and all his lips had said / With the blessings of goodness, fine gold crowns his head
He asked you for life; length of days forever you gave / Great glory, honor, majesty upon him you laid
You bless him forever, make him glad in your sight / He trusts in Yahweh; Most High’s love keeps him upright
Your hand will find your enemies, each one you seek / Your right hand finds all those who hate you, within reach
You make them like a fiery furnace in your anger’s flame / Yahweh will swallow them in wrath; fire shall devour them all the same
Their evil plots fail; you erase their offspring’s trace / You make them turn their backs when drawn bows aim at their face
Be exalted, Yahweh, let your strength be shown / We sing and we give praise for your power, made known
My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? / Why are You far from helping, from my groaning plea?
By day I cry, and all night long I call out, / You do not answer; I am not silent at all.
You are holy; in Israel’s praise You make Your place, / You heard the afflicted, never hid Your face.
Our fathers trusted You, and cried to You for aid, / You delivered them; their trust was not betrayed.
I am a worm, no man, by the people all despised, / They say, “He trusts in Yahweh; let Him save him, since He delights.”
You brought me from the womb; at breast my trust was born, / I was cast on You; my God since mother bore me.
Trouble is near; no one can help; no aid is found, / Strong bulls of Bashan circle; lion roars resound.
I am poured out like water; my bones are out of joint, / My heart melts like wax; strength dries, tongue sticks; death’s dust is my plight.
Dogs and evildoers surround; my hands and feet they pierce, / I count my bones; they stare at me, their gazes fierce.
They divide my garments, splitting them to share, / They cast lots for my clothing, choosing what to wear.
Yahweh, don’t be far; my help, hurry; hear my plea, / Save soul from sword, dog’s power; lion; ox horns, You rescued me.
Among my brothers, I’ll declare Your name in the assembly, / My vows I pay before those who fear You, praising Your name.
Let Jacob’s seed praise, glorify, stand awed before Yahweh, / The humble eat, are filled; seekers praise; live evermore.
Earth’s ends remember, turn to Yahweh; all nations bow, / Yahweh’s is the kingdom; He rules the nations now.
The rich eat and worship; dust-bound bow, none keep souls alive, / Posterity serves; to those born, His righteousness they describe.
Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing at all / Makes me lie down in green pastures; leads me by still waters
He restores my soul; His paths are righteous and right / For His name’s sake He guides me along them aright
Though I walk through death’s shadowed valley, I fear no evil / For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me
You set a table before me, in sight of my foes / You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows
Goodness and loving kindness follow me all my days / I’ll dwell in Yahweh’s house, where I will always stay
The earth and all its fullness are Yahweh’s own / The world and all who dwell in it are His alone
He founded it on seas and set it in its place / Established on the floods, made firm upon that base
Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill and reach its height? / Who may stand in His holy place before His sight?
Clean hands, a pure heart; his soul has not turned to lies / Nor sworn an oath deceitfully, in any guise
He shall receive Yahweh’s blessing as his own / Righteousness from God of his salvation, shown
This is the generation of those who seek His face / They seek your face—even Jacob among their race
Lift up your heads, you gates; everlasting doors, rise / The King of glory will come in; lift up your eyes
Who is the King of glory? Yahweh, strong and mighty / Yahweh mighty in battle; Yahweh of Armies, glory’s King
Yahweh, I lift my soul; my God, I trust in Thee / Don’t let my foes shame me, nor let them triumph over me
Those who wait for Yahweh will not suffer shame / The treacherous without cause, they will be shamed
Show me Your ways; teach me Your paths, guide me in Your way / Teach me Your truth; You are my saving God, I wait all day
Remember ancient mercies, Lord, the love You showed before / Forget my youthful sins and wrongs; remember me once more
Good and upright Yahweh instructs sinners in His way / He guides the humble in justice, teaches them what’s right
Because my sin is great, for Your name, forgive me / Those who fear You know Your friendship; Your covenant they see
My eyes stay fixed on Yahweh; my trust is anchored there / He plucks my feet out from the net that formed the snare
Desolate and afflicted, my heart’s troubles increase / Oh bring me out of my distress; grant me release
Consider my affliction; forgive all sins I bear / My many enemies hate me; their hatred is severe
I take refuge; let integrity preserve me as I wait / Redeem Israel, O God, from every troubled state
Judge me, Yahweh; examine my heart and mind / I’ve walked in integrity, my trust won’t unwind
Your loving-kindness, it stays before my sight / I walk in Your truth and keep my steps upright
I have not sat with deceitful men, nor joined the false way / I hate evildoers’ assembly; with the wicked I won’t stay
I wash my hands in innocence, then draw near / I go about Your altar, Yahweh, to declare
I make my thanks be heard aloud, ringing clear / I tell of all Your wondrous deeds for all to hear
I love Your house, where Your glory has its dwelling place / Prove me, Yahweh; try my heart and mind, examine my case
Do not gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with men / Whose hands do wickedness; right hands brim with bribes then
I will walk in integrity; redeem me, I pray / Be merciful to me, Yahweh; hear my plea today
My foot stands in an even place, firm on the ground / In congregations, I bless Yahweh; my praises resound
Yahweh’s my light and salvation; whom shall I fear? / Yahweh’s the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
My foes came to eat my flesh; they stumbled, met their fall / Though war rise or armies encamp, my heart won’t fear at all
One thing I ask of Yahweh: dwell in his house all my days / See Yahweh’s beauty, inquire in his temple’s ways
In trouble, his pavilion hides me; he lifts me on a rock / My head above foes; in his tent, joy offerings and praise
Hear my cry now, show me your mercy, and answer my plea / You said, “Seek my face”; my heart said, “I seek you, Yahweh”
Don’t hide your face; don’t cast me off in anger; you’ve helped me / When father and mother forsake me, Yahweh will take me up
Teach me your way; lead straight, don’t hand me to my foes / False witnesses rise against me; cruelty from them flows
I’ll see Yahweh’s goodness in the living land, I’m sure / Wait for Yahweh; be strong, take courage; wait once more
Yahweh, my Rock, hear my call; don't turn deaf to it / If silent, I'll be like those who go down to the pit
Hear all my petitions, the plea that I raise / I lift up my hands toward Your Most Holy Place
Don't draw me with wicked who tell neighbors, “Peace” / While mischief fills their hearts beneath their speech
Repay them for all they have done, every one / By the work of their hands, let the reckoning be done
Since they disregard Your works, You will break them down / And never build them up again from the ground
Bless Yahweh, who heard my petitions; He's my strength and my shield / My heart trusted, was helped, rejoices; thanks in song I yield
Yahweh is strength for His people, their power / For His anointed, salvation's sure and strong tower
Save Your people; bless Your inheritance, we implore / Be their shepherd; bear them up forevermore
Ascribe Yahweh glory and strength, you mighty, proclaim / Worship Yahweh in holy array; honor his name
His voice breaks Lebanon’s cedars; they crash to the ground / Lebanon and Sirion leap like a young wild ox unbound
His voice flashes lightning, bright bolts fill the air / It shakes the wilderness of Kadesh as bolts flare
The deer give birth as his voice strips the forests bare / In his temple all say, “Glory!”; the cry rings clear
Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood, ruling on high / He reigns as King forever; his rule will not die
I extol Yahweh, for you raised me up on high / You kept all my foes from cheering in delight
I cried to Yahweh; you healed me, made me whole / You raised my soul from Sheol, kept me from the hole
Yahweh’s saints, sing praise to him; lift up your voice / Give thanks unto his holy name and rejoice
His anger lasts a moment; his favor spans a lifetime / Weeping may stay the night; joy comes with morning light
In prosperity, I said, “I shall never be moved” / You favored me; my mountain stood strong, its strength proved
When you hid your face, Yahweh, I felt dismay / I cried to you, Yahweh, and made my plea that day
Yahweh, have mercy, help me; what profit down there? / Can dust praise you, or can it lay your truth bare?
You turned my mourning into dance, took sackcloth away / Clothed me with gladness; heart sings praise, won't stay silent, thanks always
In you, Yahweh, I take refuge; let me not be ashamed / Deliver in righteousness; be rock, my stronghold, lead, pluck nets laid
I commend my spirit; you redeem me, God of truth / I hate those who trust vain lies; Yahweh, I put trust in you
Your kindness makes me glad; you saw my grief, knew my soul / You set my feet in open space, beyond the enemy’s control
Have mercy, Yahweh, distressed; my eyes, soul, body waste away / My life spent in sorrow, years sigh; strength fails through sin, bones decay
My foes made me contemptible; neighbors turn away / Forgotten like a dead man, broken pottery of clay
By slander and terror on every side I’m beset / They conspire and plot together my life to get
I say, “You are my God”; my times are in your hand / Deliver me; shine on your servant; let your light descend
Let me not be shamed; let the wicked be shamed, silent with the dead / Mute lying lips that scorn the righteous, proud in what they said
How great your goodness, worked for those who fear you before men / You hide them from all the plots of men, from tongues’ strife, unseen
Yahweh showed me marvelous love in the strong city; I praise / I thought in haste you cut me off; you heard my voice when I prayed
Love Yahweh, all you saints; he keeps the faithful in his hold / He repays the proud; all who hope in him, be strong and bold
Blessed is the one whose wrong is pardoned, sin concealed / Yahweh counts no iniquity; his spirit holds no deceit
When I kept silent, my bones wasted away / My groaning carried on through the whole day
Your hand lay heavy over me by day and night / The summer heat sapped all my strength with its bite
I acknowledged my sin to you, hid no transgression / I said, “I’ll confess to Yahweh”; you gave remission
Let every godly person pray while you may be found / Though great waters overflow, they will not reach him
You are my hiding place; from trouble you preserve me / Songs of deliverance surround me all around
I’ll teach you the way you should go, with my eye on you / Don’t be like horse or mule, senseless, bit-led; they won’t come near you, though
Many sorrows come to the wicked; Yahweh’s love surrounds the trusting / Be glad in Yahweh, righteous; upright hearts, shout for joy!
Righteous rejoice; praise Yahweh, let the lyre strings ring / Ten harp strings; play a new song skillfully, shout as you sing
Yahweh’s word is right; his faithful works all stand / He loves righteousness and justice; mercy fills land
By word and breath, the heavens and their host were made / He heaps up sea waters; the deep in vaults is laid
All earth, fear Yahweh; stand in awe at his command / He speaks, and it is done; his command is firm
Yahweh brings nations’ counsel to nothing; their plans fail / His counsel stands through generations; forever prevails
Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh / His chosen people, his inheritance, are they
From heaven Yahweh sees all humankind below / He fashions every heart; all their deeds he knows
Kings and armies, warriors, horses cannot save from death / He sees those who fear, hope in his love; keeps them alive in famine
We wait for Yahweh, our help and shield; our hearts rejoice / His holy name we trust; in him our hearts find joy
Yahweh, let your loving kindness rest on us, we ask / Since we have hoped in you, our hope holds fast
I bless Yahweh at all times; his praise is in my mouth / My soul boasts in Yahweh; humble hear, glad, exalt his name now
I sought Yahweh; he answered, drove all my fears to flight / Those looking toward him shine; no shame can dim their light
This poor man cried; Yahweh heard and saved him from each plight / His angel camps around those who fear him, delivers outright
Taste and see Yahweh is good; blessed who take refuge within / Fear Yahweh, you saints; there’s no lack for those who fear him
The young lions go hungry; no food can they find / Those seeking Yahweh lack no good thing of any kind
Come, children, hear; I teach Yahweh’s fear; who longs for life and good days / Keep tongue from evil, lips from lies; do good, pursue peace always
Yahweh watches the righteous; their cry reaches his ear / His face against evildoers; their memory from earth disappears
Yahweh is near the brokenhearted; the crushed he saves / The righteous face many afflictions; deliverance he gives
Yahweh protects every bone beneath his guard / Not one of them is broken, nor cracked or marred
Evil kills the wicked; those who hate the righteous are condemned / Yahweh redeems his servants; none taking refuge are condemned
Yahweh, contend; take shield and buckler, come to my aid / Brandish your spear; block those pursuing me with its blade
Tell my soul, “I am your salvation,” speak it clear / Let their way be dark and slippery; your angel drives them like chaff in the wind
Without cause they hid their net and dug a pit for me / Let ruin catch him unaware; his own net traps him there
My soul rejoices in Yahweh, saved by him, filled with joy / My bones cry, “Who like you saves the poor and needy from the robber’s power?”
Unjust witnesses accuse me of things I don’t know / They repay my good with evil, leave my soul sunk low
When sick, I wore sackcloth, fasted; my prayer returned to my breast / I treated them as friend and brother, bowed, mourning mother’s death
When in distress, they rejoiced, gathered, tore without cease / They gnashed their teeth like mockers gathered at a feast
Lord, how long? Rescue my soul from their destruction’s tide / Save my precious life from the lions at my side
I’ll thank Yahweh in the great assembly, among the throng / Among the many people, I’ll praise him with song
Don’t let my foes rejoice unjustly or wink at me without cause / They speak no peace, deceive the quiet, shout, “Aha! Our eye has seen!”
You have seen this, Yahweh; don’t be silent, draw near / Rise, defend me; vindicate me in your righteousness, hear
Confound and shame those gloating, dishonor those proud in their might / Don’t let them say, “Aha, we want this! We’ve swallowed him outright!”
Those favor my just cause rejoice: “Yahweh be magnified!” they say / My tongue speaks of his righteousness, his praise all through the day
The wicked have no fear of God before their eyes. / They flatter themselves too much to see or hate their vice.
His mouth speaks iniquity and deceit; he's ceased to be wise. / He plots on his bed, sets paths not good, and won't evil despise.
Your love and faithfulness reach the skies; Your righteousness, mountain-high. / Your judgments are a great deep; You keep man and beast alive.
How precious is Your loving-kindness, God, that refuge brings. / The children take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
Your house’s bounty satisfies; its stores overflow. / You give them drink from pleasure’s river, where its waters flow.
With You, the spring of life wells up and waters rise. / In Your light, the light is revealed to our sight.
Continue Your kindness to those who know You; let righteousness stay / With upright hearts; keep pride’s foot and wicked hands away.
There, the workers of iniquity have taken a fall. / Thrust down, they shall not be able to rise at all.
Trust in Yahweh, do good; dwell safe in the land / Enjoy the safe pasture; there you can take your stand
Delight yourself in Yahweh; let your heart rejoice / He grants your heart’s desires, answering its voice
Commit your way to Yahweh; trust him to make it right / He makes your justice noon-bright, your righteousness light
Rest in Yahweh; wait there patiently, and stay / Don’t fret at the wicked who prosper their way
Cease from anger; forsake wrath, turn it away / Don’t fret; it leads only to evil, keep it at bay
The wicked are cut off; those who wait inherit their share / The humble find peace in abundance, beyond compare
The wicked plot against the just, gnashing teeth as they sneer / Yahweh laughs, for he sees their own day drawing near
They draw sword and bend bow against the upright poor / Their swords pierce their own hearts; their bows can do no more
A little the righteous have is better than wicked wealth / The wicked’s arms are broken; Yahweh upholds the just himself
Yahweh knows the days of the just; their inheritance will endure / They won’t be disappointed in evil; in famine they’re secure
The wicked perish, like field flowers that die / They vanish like smoke as it drifts through the sky
The wicked may borrow and don’t repay what they owe / Righteous give freely; blessed inherit, cursed ones go
Yahweh establishes a man’s steps and delights in his way / Though he stumbles, he won’t fall; Yahweh holds him each day
I’ve been young and now am old; the just weren’t cast aside / Their children never begged for bread; their needs were supplied
Yahweh loves justice; his saints are preserved forever / The children of the wicked are cut off altogether
I saw the wicked in power, like green tree on native ground / He passed; I sought him, but no trace of him was found
The righteous find salvation in Yahweh, their stronghold in strife / He rescues those who take refuge in him, preserving their life
Yahweh, don’t rebuke or chasten me in wrath now / Your arrows have pierced me; Your hand presses down
My flesh and bones lack health; my wounds rot from folly in me / My iniquities rise over my head; too heavy for me
I am pained, bowed greatly; all day in mourning I go / My waist is burning, my flesh is unsound; my heart groans in woe
My desire lies before You; my groans are known / My heart throbs, strength fails, and my eyes’ light is gone
My lovers and friends stand aloof; my kin keep far away / Those seeking my life set snares, speak harm, plot deceit all day
Like one who is deaf and mute, I don’t hear a word / I keep my mouth shut; no rebuke can be heard
I hope in Yahweh; my God will answer my call / Don’t let them gloat when my foot slips, or stand tall
My pain stays before me; I’m ready to fall / I’ll confess my iniquity, grieve for it all
My foes are vigorous and many; they hate me without cause / They repay good with evil, because I follow what is good
Don’t forsake me, Yahweh; my God, don’t turn away / Hurry to help, Lord, my salvation; don’t delay
I said, I’ll guard my ways, lest my tongue bring sin / With wicked before me, I kept my mouth reined in
I stayed mute; held peace from good; my sorrow stirred inside / My heart burned hot; I mused; fire burned; my tongue replied
Show me my end, Yahweh; measure the days I span / Let me know my frailty; help me understand
Before You, days are handbreadths; my lifetime counts as naught / Each walks as shadow, heaps in vain, knows not who’ll gather his lot
Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in Thee / Deliver me from transgressions; don’t let fools reproach me
I did not open my mouth; You did it; I stayed hushed / Remove Your scourge; Your hand’s blow has left me crushed
You rebuke, correct man for sin; moths consume his wealth / Surely every man stands as nothing but breath
Hear my prayer, Yahweh, heed my cry; don’t silence tears; stranger with You / As all my fathers were; spare me, restore strength ere I’m no more
I waited patiently; Yahweh turned and heard my cry / He raised me from the pit and mire; on rock my feet stand firm
He put a new song of praise in my mouth for our God / Many shall see it, fear, trust Yahweh, and be awed
Blessed is he who trusts Yahweh, not proud nor those turned to lies / Your works and thoughts toward us are more than can be counted
You did not desire sacrifice, burnt or sin offerings / I delight to do Your will; Your law’s my everything
In the great assembly, Your righteousness I declare / My lips stay open; Your faithful love, salvation, truth I share
Don’t withhold tender mercy; let love and truth preserve me / Evils surround; sins more than hairs; my heart fails, I can’t look up
Yahweh, hurry, rescue me; bring my foes to shame / All who seek You rejoice; let Yahweh be acclaimed
Poor and needy, think of me, Yahweh, I pray / You are my help and deliverer; don’t delay
Blessed is the one who considers the poor in their need / Yahweh delivers him when evil takes the lead
Yahweh sustains him on his sickbed through sickness’s toll / He restores him from his sickbed, makes him whole
Yahweh, have mercy on me; come and heal me / I confess that I have sinned against thee
My foes ask, “When will he die, his name perish?” they cry / They say, “An evil disease struck; he’ll never rise.”
My familiar friend, whom I trusted, shared bread with me / He lifted up his heel against me, treacherously
By this I know you delight; my foe won’t triumph over me / You uphold me in integrity, in presence eternally
As the deer pants for water brooks, my soul pants after you / My soul thirsts for the living God; when shall I appear before thee?
My tears have been my food by night and by day / “Where is your God?” they continually say
I led the joyful crowd to God’s house in praise / A multitude kept holy day, their voices raised
My soul, why despair? Why disturbed within? Hope in God! / For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence
My God, my soul despairs within; so I remember you still / From the land of Jordan, Hermon’s heights, and Mizar’s hill
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls’ roar / Your waves and billows have swept over me, all
Yahweh will command his loving kindness by day / At night his song shall be with me; to my life's God I pray
I ask God, my Rock, “Why have you forgotten me?” / “Why do I mourn beneath the oppression of my enemy?”
My adversaries reproach me like a sword in my bones / They continually ask, “Where is your God?” in questioning tones
Vindicate me, God; plead my cause against the ungodly nation / Deliver me from deceitful, wicked men; grant liberation
For You are God of my strength; why have You cast me away? / Why do I mourn beneath the enemy’s oppressive sway?
Send out Your light and truth; let them lead me as my guide / Bring me to Your holy hill, to Your tents where You abide
Then I'll go to God’s altar, to God, my exceeding joy / I will praise You on the harp, God, my God, and rejoice
Why are you in despair, my soul, disturbed by the strain? / Hope in God; I’ll praise my Savior, helper, and God again.
Our fathers told how You drove nations from the land / You drove them out and planted us there by Your hand
No sword or arm of theirs could claim the land as home / Your hand, Your arm, Your face’s light made favor known
You are my King; command Jacob to triumph o'er foes / Through Your name we tread down all foes who dare oppose
My bow I will not trust; my sword can't save my life / You saved us from our foes, shamed those who bore spite
In God we boast all day, our voices raised in praise / We thank Your name forever, through all our days
You reject us now; our armies fight alone / You make us turn back; our foes take plunder for their own
You make us sheep for food, scattered far away / You sell Your people for no gain, and take no pay
Our neighbors reproach us, mock us, deride us with scorn / Among nations, a byword; the peoples’ heads shake in scorn
We haven't forgotten Your covenant, nor strayed from Your way / Though You crushed us where jackals dwell, death’s shadow over us lay
Should we forget Your name, or worship gods not our own / Would God not search? Our hearts’ secrets to Him are known
For Your sake, like sheep for slaughter, all day we lay / Wake, Lord, why sleep? Rise; let rejection pass away
Our souls bow down to dust; our bodies cling to clay / Rise, help; redeem us for Your lovingkindness, we pray
My heart overflows with a noble theme; for the king I recite / My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer, poised to write
You are the most excellent of the sons of men / Grace has anointed your lips; God blessed you without end
Strap your sword upon your thigh, mighty one, in splendor and might / Ride in triumph for truth, meekness, and right; your right hand works wonders
Your arrows are sharp; the nations fall beneath you / They pierce the hearts of the king’s enemies, all
Your throne, God, endures forever; your scepter rules in equity / You love right, hate evil; your God anoints you with joy above peers
Myrrh, aloes, cassia scent robes; ivory-palace strings make glad / Kings’ daughters among honored women; queen at your right wears Ophir gold
Daughter, listen, turn your ear; the king will desire your beauty / Forget your people and father’s house; honor your lord, revere
Tyre’s daughter brings a gift; the rich entreat your favor / Glorious, gold-woven, the princess led to the king; her maids follow
Your sons will take their fathers’ place as princes throughout the earth / I’ll make your name remembered; peoples thank you forevermore
God is our refuge and strength when trouble draws near / A very present help when trouble is here
Though the earth may change, still we will not fear its sway / Mountains plunge into the sea; waters roar in disarray
The river streams make glad God's city as they flow / The holy place where Most High's tents have their abode
God is within her; she will securely stay / At dawn God will help her, at the break of day
The nations raged, and kingdoms shook beneath the sky / He lifted His voice; the earth melted under His cry
Yahweh of Armies is with us, at our side / The God of Jacob is our refuge, where we abide
Come see Yahweh’s works, the desolations he has made in the earth / Ends wars at earth's edge; breaks bow, shatters spear, burns chariots in flame
“Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted” / “Among the nations, in the earth, I will be exalted”
All nations, clap your hands and let your praise resound / Let every voice shout out in triumph, strong and loud
Yahweh Most High is awesome, a great King over earth / God subdues nations under us; peoples beneath our feet
He chooses our inheritance, our allotted share / Jacob’s glory, whom he loved, is ours to share
God has gone up with a shout; his triumph rings high / Yahweh goes up with the sound of a trumpet on high
Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Let the songs ring clear / Sing praises to our King, with understanding clear
God is King of all the earth; God reigns over the nations / God sits upon his holy throne, exalted above the nations
The princes gather with the people of Abraham’s God / The shields of earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted
Yahweh is great, greatly praised in God's own town / On his holy mountain, where the city is found
Mount Zion, the whole earth’s joy, beautiful in height / The great King’s city; God her citadels’ refuge in sight
Kings gathered, saw, amazed, then fled in fright / Trembling seized them; labor pains gripped them tight
With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish at sea / God will establish it forever, as we have heard and seen
In your temple we ponder the love you have shown / Your name and praise reach earth’s ends; your right hand’s righteousness known
Zion be glad; Judah rejoice at your judgments’ execution / Walk round Zion, count towers; inspect bulwarks and palaces; tell generations
This God is ours, our guide, forever and ever / He guides us even unto death, forever
All peoples, high and low, must hear the summons clear / Both poor and rich together, all the world must hear
My mouth speaks words of wisdom; my heart utters understanding / I bend my ear to a proverb, solve my riddle on the harp
Why fear in evil days, when sin crowds at my rear? / Those rich trust wealth and boast in riches far and near
None can redeem a brother, nor give God ransom pay / No payment buys him endless life or keeps decay away
Wise men and fools die; their wealth to others is passed / They name their lands for self, think homes will forever last
Though rich, a man cannot endure; his wealth won’t save / Like animals that perish, he is bound for the grave
Death shepherds fools to Sheol; the upright rule at dawn / Their beauty fades in Sheol, from mansions they are gone
God will redeem my soul from Sheol; he will receive me / A rich man without understanding perishes like beasts, you see
Fear not when a man grows rich, his house’s glory gains height / When dead, he carries nothing; his glory won’t follow his flight
While living, he blesses his soul; men praise his worldly gain / He joins his fathers’ line; they never see the light again
Yahweh calls the earth from sunrise till sunset’s glow / From Zion, perfection of beauty, his radiance flows
He comes, not silent; fire devours, storms rage around / He calls heaven and earth to judge; covenant saints gather round
The heavens declare his righteousness, made known / For God himself is judge, as the heavens have shown
“Your offerings are always before me; I don’t rebuke / No bull from your stall, no goat from your pen do I seek.
Forest beasts, hill herds, mountain birds, field creatures are mine / The whole world and all that is in it, they are mine
Give thanks, keep vows, call on me when you’re in need / I will deliver; your honor I’ll receive.
What right to declare my statutes, my covenant you speak? / You hate my instruction; my words you cast away, not keep.
You join with thieves and adulterers; share their sin / Your tongue frames deceit and slanders your kin.
I kept my silence; you thought I was just like you, too / Before your eyes I rebuke, accuse; heed, lest I tear you.
Whoever offers thanks thereby glorifies me / And prepares his way; my salvation he’ll see.”
Have mercy, God; wash me thoroughly from sin / Blot out my transgressions; cleanse me and make me clean
I know my transgressions; my sin stays in sight / Against You alone I sinned; Your judgment is right
Born in iniquity, conceived in sin at the start / You desire truth within; teach wisdom to my heart
Purge me with the hyssop; then wash me clean and snow-white / Let me hear joy and gladness; bones You broke rejoice outright
Hide Your face from my sins; blot out my iniquities / Create a clean heart; renew a right spirit in me
Don’t cast me from Your presence; don’t take Your Holy Spirit away / Restore salvation’s joy; uphold me with willing spirit, I pray
Deliver me from bloodguilt, God; I’ll teach transgressors Your ways / Open my lips; my tongue sings Your righteousness, declares Your praise
You don’t delight in sacrifice, nor burnt offerings prize / A broken spirit, contrite heart You will not despise
Do good to Zion; rebuild Jerusalem’s walls aright / Then righteous, burnt, whole-burnt offerings; bulls on altar delight
Why boast of mischief, mighty man, while kindness remains? / God’s own loving kindness endures; it never wanes.
Your tongue plots destruction, sharp as a razor blade; / It works deceitfully; those plots are slyly laid.
You love evil more than good, and choose the lie; / You love devouring words, and your tongue is sly.
God will destroy you and pluck you from your home; / He’ll root you from the land where the living roam.
The righteous see, fear, laugh: “Behold, he did wrong; / He made not God his strength; in wickedness grew strong.”
In the house of God, I'm like a green olive tree; / I trust his loving kindness eternally.
Forever I will give you thanks, because you have done it; / I hope in your good name before your saints, every one.
The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God”—that thought / They’re corrupt; abominable iniquity they have wrought
They’ve all turned back together, filthy and unclean / No one does good—not one; no good is ever seen
God looks down from heaven on the human race / To see if any understand and seek his face
They devour God’s people like a loaf of bread / They do not call on God; his name is left unsaid
They were seized with great fear, though fear had no claim / God scatters their foe’s bones, and puts them to shame
Oh, let salvation come from Zion; let God restore / God brings them back; Jacob and Israel rejoice once more
Save me, God, by your name; vindicate me in your might / Hear my prayer, God; listen to the words I recite
Strangers have risen up against me; they assail / Violent men seek my soul; God not set before them at all
Behold, God is my helper; the Lord sustains my soul / He will repay evil to foes; destroy them in your truth
With a freewill offering, I sacrifice, as I should / I give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good
For he has delivered me from all troubles and woes / My eye has seen triumph over my enemies, my foes
God, hear my prayer; don’t hide from my earnest plea / Their voice and oppression bring suffering to me
My heart is severely pained; death’s terrors fell / Fear, trembling, and horror overwhelm me as well
With wings like a dove, I’d fly away and find rest / Far off, I’d lodge in wilds, seek shelter from the tempest
Confound their speech; violence in the city reigns / Day and night they prowl walls; malice, threats, lies haunt lanes
An enemy’s insult, I could have endured, that’s true / But you, close friend, shared sweet fellowship, God’s house with me too
Let sudden death come; let them descend alive / To Sheol, where wickedness among them thrives
At dusk, at dawn, at noon, I cry in distress / Yahweh hears; he redeems me in peace though foes press
The enthroned God hears; the godless won’t amend / He raises his hand against friends; the covenant he rends
His mouth was smooth as butter; his heart was war / His words softer than oil, yet drawn swords they are
Cast your burden on Yahweh; he sustains the just / Bloodthirsty deceivers won’t live half their days; I trust
God, show me mercy; man wants to swallow me all day / They attack and oppress; proud foes join the fray
When I'm afraid, then I will put my trust in you / In God I praise his word; I trust, won't fear—what flesh can do?
All day they twist my words; their evil thoughts are against me / They conspire and lurk, watch my steps, my life to seize
Shall they escape by iniquity, unbound? / In anger cast the peoples down, God, to the ground
You count my wandering steps, wherever I roam / My tears are in your flask, in your book they’re known
When I call, my enemies retreat and go their ways / I know God is for me; in Yahweh his word I praise
Your vows are on me, God; they are resting upon me / I will be giving thank offerings to thee
You saved my soul from death, kept both my feet upright / So I may walk before God in the living light
Have mercy, God; beneath your wings my soul can hide / In your shadow till disaster has passed by
God Most High fulfills my requests, sends rescue from above / He rebukes my pursuer, sends his truth and love
My soul is among lions, with men in a burning horde / Their teeth are spears and arrows; each tongue is a sword
Be exalted, God, above the heavens, in the sky / Let your glory be above all the earth, held high
They set a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down low / They dig a pit before me; they fall into its middle below
My heart is steadfast, God; I will sing your praise / Wake, my glory, lute and harp; wake dawn’s first rays
Among the peoples, Lord, my thanks to you I raise / Among the nations, Lord, I will sing your praise
Your great loving kindness reaches up to the skies / Your truth, it reaches up to the heavens’ height
Silent ones, do you speak what is righteous and fair? / Sons of men, do you judge without blame anywhere?
No, in your hearts you plot injustice; your hands / Measure out violence on earth across its lands
The wicked stray from the womb, born wayward, speaking lies / Poison’s like snake’s; deaf cobra shuts ear to skilled charmers’ cries
God, break the teeth within their mouths; let their teeth fall / Yahweh, break the young lions’ great teeth; break them all
Let them vanish like water that streams from sight / When they draw the bow, blunt each arrow in flight
Like a snail melting away, let them pass away / Like a stillborn child who never saw the sun’s day
Before your pots feel thorns’ heat, he sweeps the green away / The burning too, alike, he sweeps without delay
Righteous rejoice, wash feet in wicked blood when vengeance unfurled / Men say, “Most surely, righteous have reward; God judges the world.”
Save me from bloodthirsty men who threaten my life / Set me on high above those who rise to fight
I have done no wrong, nor sinned, yet face their might / Mighty men lie in wait, prepared to strike
Yahweh, God of Armies, Israel’s God, arise / Punish nations; spare no wicked traitor who lies
At evening, they return, like dogs whose howls you hear / They spew from their mouths, swords on their lips: “Who hears us?” they say
Yahweh laughs, scoffing at all the nations, one and all / My Strength, I watch for you, my high tower standing tall
Do not kill them, lest my people forget it all / By your power, scatter them and make them fall
Consume them in wrath for their proud curses and lies / Let them know God rules in Jacob, to earth’s far sides
They wander for food, wait all night if not satisfied / At dawn I sing your strength and love, my refuge in distress
O God, You rejected us and broke us down / You have been angry; O God, restore us now
You made the land tremble; You have torn it apart / Mend its fractures, for it quakes in every part
You showed Your people hard things; a hard ordeal / You made us drink the wine that makes us reel
You gave those who fear You a banner to display / Save Your beloved with Your right hand; answer us, we pray
God spoke from His sanctuary: “I will triumph,” said I / “I’ll measure Succoth’s valley; Shechem I divide”
“Gilead and Manasseh are mine; Ephraim guards my head” / “Judah is my scepter,” the words that God has said
“Moab’s My wash basin; on Edom My sandal I’ll throw” / “Over Philistia I shout; my triumph I show”
Who brings me to the strong city? Who leads me to Edom? / Haven’t You, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies
Give help against the foe; human aid cannot hold ground / Through God we act with valor; He treads our foes down
Hear my cry, O God, and listen to my prayer / O God, hear my cry, and listen to my prayer
My heart overwhelmed, from earth’s far edge I cry / Lead me to the rock that stands higher than I
You have been my refuge, strong tower from foes / Your strong tower shields me from the enemy’s blows
I will dwell in Your tent through all endless days / Beneath Your wings, I will take refuge and stay
You heard my vows and gave me a rightful share / Among all those who fear Your name, I’m an heir
You will prolong the king’s life; his years extend / His years will be for generations to the end
He shall be enthroned in Your presence forever / Appoint Your loving kindness and truth to preserve him
I will sing praise to Your name forevermore / Each day I will fulfill all the vows I swore
My soul rests in God alone; salvation comes from him / He alone is rock, salvation, fortress; I won’t be greatly shaken
How long will you assault a man, one and all? / Would all of you throw him down, like leaning wall or fence?
They, they do mean to cast him down from his lofty place / They delight in lies; bless with their mouths, curse inwardly in his face
My soul, wait silently now for God alone / My expectation is from him alone
Trust in him at all times; pour out your heart before him / God is a refuge for us; take refuge in him
Low men are breath, high men are lies; in scales they weigh less than breath / Trust not oppression, boast not in theft, nor set your heart on wealth
God spoke once; twice I heard: all power belongs to you / Lord, loving-kindness is yours; you reward each for what they do
My God, I earnestly seek you; my soul thirsts in this land / My flesh longs for you in this dry land with no water at hand
I saw you in the sanctuary, power and glory in sight / I think of you on my bed through the watches of night
Your loving kindness is better than life itself / So my lips shall praise you through all of my life
While I live, I bless you throughout all my days / I will lift up my hands in your name, with praise
My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest fare / My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips in prayer
Your help lets me rejoice beneath your wings, in your care / My soul stays close; your right hand holds me up there
Those who seek my soul to destroy go down below / They are given to the sword; jackals feast on the foe
The king rejoices in God; all who swear by him will / Praise him; the mouths that speak lies are silenced still
God, hear my voice as I make my complaint clear / Preserve my life from fear of the enemy near
Hide me from the wicked, from their noisy crowd / Their tongues sharpen like swords, aim arrows of deadly words
They shoot the innocent from ambush, sudden, unafraid / They encourage themselves in evil plans they’ve made
They plot in secret, sure no one will ever know / “We have made a perfect plan!” the plotters crow
But God will shoot at them; his arrow takes flight / They are suddenly struck down by his arrow’s might
Their own tongues shall ruin them; their downfall will show / All who see them will shake their heads at the evil they sow
All of mankind shall fear; God’s works they’ll declare / They wisely ponder all that God has done with care
Righteous are glad in Yahweh, and take refuge in him / All upright in heart shall praise him with a hymn
In Zion, praise awaits our God; each vow is paid / He hears each prayer; all people will come his way
Our sins overwhelmed us; you atoned for the wrongs we bore / Blessed whom you choose and draw near; your courts fill us as goodness pours
By awesome righteous deeds you answer us, God of our salvation / You are the hope of earth's far ends and those far off at sea
By his strength he forms the mountains rising o’er the land / He stills the seas and waves; nations’ turmoil yields to his hand
Far peoples fear his wonders, frightened at the sight / Dawn and evening are summoned; songs of joy take flight
He visits earth and waters it; his river's full, it flows / He greatly enriches it, gives them grain as he chose
He drenches furrows, levels ridges; showers soften ground / He blesses its crop; the year with bounty is crowned
His carts overflow; glad grasslands and hills rejoice / Flocks blanket the pastures; grain-clad valleys raise their voice
Let all the earth shout joyfully to God and sing / Sing glory to His name; offer praise, let songs ring
Tell God: Your deeds awesome; power makes foes submit to You / All earth will worship You, sing to You and to Your name, too
He turned the sea to dry land; they went through the river on foot / There we rejoiced in Him; they went through the river on foot
God rules forever; His eyes watch every land / Let none who rebel rise to challenge His command
All the peoples, praise our God; let His praise be clearly heard / He keeps our lives among living; our feet won’t be stirred
You tested and refined us like silver; in prison, backs burdened too / Men rode our heads; through fire and water, abundance came from You
I come with fat beasts, rams, bulls, goats, burnt offerings to Your temple / I’ll pay the vows my lips and mouth spoke when distress was mine
Come hear, all who fear God; His deeds for my soul I declare / I cried; my tongue extolled Him. If sin I cherished, He’d not hear
Blessed be God, who listened when I raised my plea / He did not turn it away, nor withdraw kindness from me
Be merciful to us, bless us; make your face shine / Let your way be known on earth, salvation for all mankind
Let all the peoples praise you, God; let all rejoice / Let nations all be glad and sing out with joy
You will judge the peoples with equity, fair / And govern all the nations on earth, everywhere
The earth has yielded its increase; God's blessings are here / Our own God will bless us; all the ends of earth shall fear
Let all the peoples praise you, God; let all praise you / All the ends of the earth shall surely fear you too
Let God arise; his enemies scatter from sight / Those who hate him flee before him, taking flight
Like wax before the fire, the wicked melt away / At God's presence, let them perish; let them decay
Righteous rejoice before God, their glad hearts sing / Sing praises to Yah, who rides clouds; let praises ring
God fathers the fatherless, gives widows his care / He dwells in holiness; his presence is there
God sets lonely in families; rebels dwell in sun-scorched land / He brings the prisoners out with singing, brought by God's own hand
God marches before his people through wilderness wide / Earth trembles; rain pours from the sky at Sinai's side
You sent abundant rain; confirmed your weary inheritance / Your congregation lived there; goodness prepared for poor
The Lord announces his word; a great company proclaims / Kings' armies flee; she who waits at home divides the gains
You lie among the campfires; dove wings gleam silver-bright / Her feathers shine with gold, a glittering sight
When God scattered kings in her, snow fell on Zalmon's height / Why envy, Bashan's rugged hills? Yah's chosen mount, home for all time
God's chariots, thousands on thousands, come streaming along / From Sinai to sanctuary, Lord marches strong
God ascends on high, leads captives away in his train / He receives gifts, even from rebels, so Yah may dwell there
Blessed be the Lord, who bears our burdens each day / God delivers; from death, Yahweh provides the way
God strikes the guilty foe, his hairy scalp laid low / “I'll bring you from Bashan, sea depths; dogs share foes' blood”
Singers lead the procession; minstrels follow in song / Women play tambourines; bless God in Israel's throng
Kings bring gifts to Jerusalem; Egypt's princes arrive / Cush stretches hands to God; all kingdoms sing his praise
Save me, God; the waters rise and reach my neck / Mire grips my feet; deep floods roll over me unchecked
I’m weary from my crying; my throat is parched and dry / My eyes grow dim as I search for my God on high
Without cause, my foes outnumber hairs upon my head / I must restore what I did not take, though falsely blamed
God, you know my foolishness; my sins are plain to see / Don’t shame those who seek or wait for you because of me
Let none who seek you be dishonored through me / For your sake, reproach has covered my face with shame
Zeal for your house consumes me; reproach on me has rained / To brothers I’m a stranger, from my mother’s children estranged
My weeping and my fasting bring me deep disgrace / I wear sackcloth, a byword; drunkards mock me to my face
Yahweh, in the welcome time, I pray; hear my plea / With abundant loving-kindness, bring salvation to me
Deliver me from mire and deep waters; don’t let me sink / Don’t let floods overwhelm; let the deep not swallow me in
I’m in distress; don’t you hide your face; quickly answer me / Draw near to my soul; redeem it; from foes, ransom me free
You know my reproach, shame, dishonor; foes stand there, each one / My heart is broken, heavy; I looked for comforters—none
They also gave me poison for my food, a bitter meal / In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink, a bitter ordeal
They persecute the one you wounded; let their table be a snare / Blot their names from life’s book; leave their homes laid bare
I’m in pain and distress; let salvation be my stay / I’ll praise God’s name with song and thanks; my voice I raise
A song of praise pleases Yahweh more than an ox as gift / The humble will see and be glad; their spirits lift
Yahweh hears the needy; his captive folk are not despised / God saves Zion, builds Judah; those who love his name reside
Come quickly, O God, and save me; bring your aid / Come quickly, Yahweh, please help me; don’t delay
Make all who seek my ruin turn back in disgrace / Those jeering “Aha!” turn back, shamed in their face
All who seek you rejoice in you and are glad in you today / Those who love your salvation say, “Let God be exalted!” each day
Poor and needy, I am; come quickly to my aid / You are my help and deliverer, Yahweh; don’t delay
Yahweh, I take refuge; in righteousness, defend / Turn your ear and save me; don't let disgrace descend
Be my rock and fortress; command my rescue now / Save me from the wicked, cruel hands that hold me down
My hope and confidence from youth, you are my stay / You brought me from the womb; I’ll praise you all my days
To many I’m a wonder; you’re my refuge strong / My mouth shall praise and honor you all day long
Don't reject me in old age; when strength fails, don't forsake me / My foes conspire: “God has left him; seize him—none can set him free!”
God, my God, hurry to help me; don't be far away / Let accusers who seek harm be consumed, shamed, dismayed
Still I will hope, add to all your praise, though full measure's beyond view / My mouth tells righteousness and salvation all day through
You taught me from my youth; don’t forsake me now I’m old / Till I declare your strength to generations yet untold
Your righteousness reaches up to heaven’s heights / You’ve done great things; none compares to you in might
You have shown us bitter troubles; you'll let me live / Bring us up from the earth’s depths; more honor and comfort give
With harp and lyre I praise your faithfulness each day / My soul, redeemed, sings praise; foes confounded, dismayed
God, give the king your justice, let him judge the people right / Your righteousness to the royal son, to judge the poor aright
Mountains bring prosperity to people everywhere / The hills bring fruit of righteousness, a harvest rich and fair
He judges poor with justice, saves needy children from their plight / He will break the oppressor into pieces with his might
They shall fear you through generations while sun and moon endure / He will come down like the rain on the mown grass, as showers on earth pour
In his days the righteous thrive; peace spreads and extends / His rule runs sea to sea, from River to earth’s ends
Tarshish and island kings bring tribute; Sheba, Seba gifts convey / All kings fall down before him; all nations serve and obey
He saves the poor who cry to him, with no helper near / He redeems them from violence; their blood he holds as dear
His name endures forever, as long as shines the sun / All nations call him blessed; by him are people blessed, each one
Praise Yahweh, Israel’s God, who alone does deeds so great / Let all the earth be filled with glory; blessed be his name
God is good to Israel, to hearts that are pure / My feet nearly slipped, envying their wealth’s allure
Free from men’s burdens, they feel no lasting strain / There are no struggles in death; their strength remains firm
Pride is their chain; their violence is their attire / Fat bulges their eyes; their conceit climbs higher
They scoff, “How does God know?” and threaten oppression with pride / Their mouths reach heaven; their tongues walk the earth wide
Surely I cleansed my heart in vain, my hands washed clean / All day I was plagued; each morning punished again
Had I said, “I will speak thus,” your children I’d betray / When I sought to understand, pain came my way
I entered God’s sanctuary, their end to discern / Their people return, drinking abundance in turn
You set them in slippery places, cast them below / The wicked live at ease and in riches they grow
How suddenly destroyed, swept off in terror’s tide / Like dreams on waking, Lord, their fantasies You despise
My soul was grieved; my heart was embittered inside / Before You, like a brute, I was senseless in mind
I am continually with You; You hold my right hand fast / You guide me with counsel and bring me to glory at last
Whom have I in heaven? None on earth I desire but You / My flesh and heart fail; God is my strength and my portion too
It is good to draw near; Yahweh is my stay / I make Him my refuge, His works I convey
Why have You rejected us forever, cast away? / Why does Your anger smolder against Your flock today?
Recall Your redeemed congregation, bought as Your own / Remember Zion, where You have dwelt, Your mountain home
The foe roars in the assembly, their standards raised / The sanctuary lies in ruins, its sacred place razed
With axes and hammers, they smash the carved work down / They burn the dwelling of Your Name right to the ground
No signs, no prophet; none among us knows how long this will last / How long foes blaspheme? Draw Your right hand; consume them fast
You are the King of old, salvation throughout the earth / They vowed, “We’ll crush them”; burned worship places to ash
You have split the sea, broke sea-beast heads, Leviathan’s too / You gave him food to people and desert creatures to chew
You opened springs, dried rivers, prepared sun and light / You set all the bounds of earth, made summer and winter right
Don’t give Your dove to wild beasts; forget not the poor / Honor Your covenant; violence fills earth’s dark floor
Arise, O God, plead Your cause; remember the fools’ jeers all day / Forget not foes’ loud voices; their tumult climbs always
We give you our thanks, O God; your name is near / Men tell of your wondrous works for all to hear
When I choose the appointed time, I judge aright / The earth and all its people quake; I hold its pillars tight
God warns the proud and wicked, “Don’t raise your horn up high” / “Don’t boast or speak with stiff necks,” he says; “don’t defy”
From neither east nor west does exaltation rise / No east or west or south can ever grant that right
God is the judge, and he puts one down below / He lifts another up, his honor to bestow
Yahweh’s hand holds the foaming wine, with spices in the cup / He pours it out; earth’s wicked drink the dregs right up
Forever I will sing to Jacob’s God his praise / The wicked horns are cut off; the righteous horns are raised
In Judah God is known; in Israel His name is great / In Israel His name is great; in Judah, God is known
His tent stands in Salem; Zion is His domain / More glorious and excellent than mountains rich with game
There He breaks the flaming arrows from the bow / All shields, swords, and weapons of war He lays low
Valiant men lie plundered, their last sleep; hands cannot rise / At His rebuke, the chariot and horse close their eyes
You, even You, are feared; Your presence strikes dread / Who can stand in Your sight when Your anger is spread?
From heaven You pronounced judgment; earth fell silent with fear / When God arose to judge and save all afflicted here
Man’s wrath surely praises You, its force turned to acclaim / The survivors of Your wrath are restrained and kept tame
Make vows unto Yahweh; fulfill them, and let all neighbors bring / Gifts to Him feared; He cuts princes’ spirit, feared by kings
My cry goes up to God for help; I beg Him to hear / In trouble I sought the Lord, hand stretched all night, untiring
My soul refused all comfort; I remember God and groan / I complain, my spirit’s overwhelmed; You hold my eyes, speech gone
I think of days of old, the ancient years gone by / I remember my night song; my heart and spirit ask why
“Will the Lord reject us forever, show favor no more? / Has lovingkindness vanished forever; does His promise fail for generations?”
“Has God forgotten grace, in anger withheld compassion?” / Then I appeal to years of the Most High’s right hand
I’ll remember Yah’s deeds and wonders from of old / I meditate on all Your work, Your doings I consider
Your way, God, is in sanctuary; what god is as great? / You made Your strength known among the peoples, plain and straight
Your arm redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph / The waters saw You and writhed; the depths convulsed
Clouds poured water; skies thundered; Your arrows flashed around / Your thunder voiced the whirlwind; lightning lit the world, earth shook
Your way was through the sea, through great waters; footsteps unknown / You led Your people like a flock by Moses and Aaron’s hand
I open my mouth with parables from of old / I utter the dark sayings our fathers have told
We tell the next generation Yahweh’s praise / His strength and wondrous deeds, passed down through their days
His covenant and teaching pass to children’s hands / They hope in God, recall his deeds, keep commands
Don’t be like stubborn, rebellious fathers of old / Keep hearts loyal, spirits steadfast; do what God told
Ephraim, armed with bows, turned back in battle’s field / They broke God’s covenant, refused his law, forgot his deeds
He split the sea; its waters rose to a height / Cloud led them by day; fire guided them by night
He split rocks in the wild; drink flowed from below / Streams ran like rivers, abundant in their flow
They sinned, tested God, demanded the food they craved / They asked, “Can God prepare a table here?”—their challenge they gave
Though angered by doubt, he opened heaven’s door / He rained down manna, angels’ bread, their daily store
He sent the winds; birds fell like sand on the ground / Around their camp, he let the birds fall around
While food was in their mouths, God’s anger struck down / Their fattest and young men fell; still sin held its ground
At death they sought their Rock, their Redeemer once more / Their mouths lied; their hearts were not true at the core
He showed mercy, forgave, and let his anger pass / He remembered they’re flesh, like wind that cannot last
Again and again they rebelled, grieving him in sand / They forgot the day he redeemed them from the enemy’s hand
Egypt’s rivers turned to blood; flies, frogs swarmed around / Locusts ate their increase; hail struck flocks on the ground
His wrath and the pestilence swept through the land / All Egypt’s firstborn, the chief strength, fell by his hand
He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, his home / He drove out nations and gave them land as their own
Again they rebelled, like a false bow bent askew / High places and idols provoked God anew
He left Shiloh; his glory fell to the foe / The sword and fire then brought Israel grief and woe
The Lord awoke like a mighty man from sleep / He struck foes backward; their shame was theirs to keep
Joseph’s tent he rejected; Ephraim he passed / Judah and Zion, beloved, were chosen at last
From out of the sheepfolds he chose David to lead / Jacob and Israel, his people, he would feed
He shepherded his people with integrity of heart / His skillful hands guided them with practiced art
Nations came into Your inheritance, Your temple defiled / They have laid Jerusalem in heaps, its ruins were piled
Your servants’ bodies fed the birds and beasts upon the ground / Their blood was shed like water; no one to bury them was found
Our neighbors mock and scorn us, heap reproach upon our name / How long, Yahweh? Will You rage forever, jealousy burn like flame?
Pour wrath on nations who don't know You, kingdoms that don't call Your name / They have devoured Jacob, and have laid waste to his domain
Don't hold our fathers' sins against us; hear our plea / We're in desperate need; let tender mercies hasten nigh
For Your name, help us, God of salvation; us deliver / And do for the sake of Your own name, our sins forgive
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it then be known / Your servants’ blood avenged before our eyes, let vengeance be shown
Repay our neighbors seven times for scorn they hurled, O Lord / We, Your flock, give thanks and praise through generations, evermore
Above the cherubim, you sit enthroned on high / Shepherd of Israel, lead Joseph like a flock; shine
Before Ephraim, Benjamin, Manasseh, stir your might / Come and save us; turn us, God; let your face shine bright
Yahweh God of Armies, how long stay angry at prayer? / You feed us tears for bread and drink; neighbors contend, foes jeer
From Egypt you brought the vine, drove nations, cleared ground / You planted it; deep-rooted, it filled the land around
Its shadow covered mountains; its branches reached the sea / Its shoots reached the River; its boughs were like God's cedars
Why break its walls, so passersby may raid the rows? / Boars ravage it; wild beasts feed where grapevine grows
Look down, visit vine, stock your right hand planted, branch made strong for you / It's burned with fire; it's cut down, and they perish at your rebuke
Let your hand rest on the son of man at your right / So we won't turn from you; revive us; we'll call your name
Sing joyfully to God; let tambourines now play / Bring lyre and harp; blow trumpet on the feast day
He set it for Joseph as covenant command / I heard a language unknown in Egypt’s land
I freed your shoulders from the burden, and hands from the basket’s load / Answered in thunder; tested you where Meribah’s waters flow
Worship no foreign gods; I’m Yahweh, brought you from Egypt’s land / Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it, as I command
My own people would not listen to my voice at all / Israel desired none of me; that was their choice
So I let their stubborn hearts pursue the path they chose / They walked according to the counsels they held close
Oh that my people would listen and walk in my ways / I’d subdue their foes; my hand against them I’d raise
Yahweh’s haters would cringe before him; their punishment won’t stop / He’d feed them finest wheat; I’ll satisfy you with honey from rock
God presides in the great assembly, over all / He judges among the gods assembled in the hall
“How long will you judge unjustly, favoring those who do wrong? / How long show partiality to the wicked—how long?”
Defend the weak, the poor, the fatherless; uphold their rights / Rescue the weak and needy from the wicked’s hands and might
They know not, nor understand; in darkness walk back and forth / Shaken are all of the foundations of the earth
I said, “You are gods, all sons of the Most High” / Nevertheless, as mortal men, you too shall die
Like one of the rulers, you will fall as men do / Arise, God, judge the earth; all nations are yours too
O God, do not be still; do not keep your silence / Do not be still, O God; do not keep silent
Your foes lift their heads; against your people they rise / They plot with cunning against the ones you prize
Edom, Ishmaelites, Moab, Hagrites, Gebal unite / Ammon, Amalek, Tyre, Philistia, Assyria align
Defeat them just as Midian, Sisera, Jabin went down / Make chiefs like Oreb, Zeeb; bring Zebah, Zalmunna to the ground
“Let’s take possession of God’s pasturelands,” they say / Make them like chaff and tumbleweed blown away
As fire burns the forest, flames set mountains alight / Pursue them with tempest and storm; fill them with fright
Fill their faces with confusion, that they seek Yahweh’s name / Disappointed, dismayed forever, confounded; none remain
At Endor they perished, like dung upon the ground / They may know Yahweh alone, Most High o'er all lands around
How lovely are Your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies, my God / My soul longs, faints for Your courts; heart, flesh cry out for the living God
The sparrow finds a home; the swallow nests her young / Near Your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King and my God
Blessed are those who dwell in Your house, praising You always / Blessed whose strength is in You, whose hearts set out on pilgrimage ways
Through Weeping’s valley they make springs; autumn rain blesses the land / They go from strength to strength, and before God in Zion they stand
Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer; God of Jacob, give ear / Behold, God our shield, look at the face of Your anointed
One day within Your courts is better than a thousand days / I’d rather be Your doorkeeper than dwell in wicked tents always
Yahweh is sun and shield; He gives grace and glory / He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly
Blessed is the one, Yahweh of Armies, who trusts in You / Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the one who trusts in You
Yahweh, you favored your land, showing your grace / You restored the fortunes of Jacob to their place
You forgave your people’s iniquity, covered all their sin / You took away all your wrath; turned from fierce anger within
“Turn us, God of our salvation; make your indignation cease” / “Will you stay angry forever, through all generations?”
“Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?” / “Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh; grant us salvation too”
I will hear God speak peace to his people, his own / But let them not turn again to folly; leave it alone
Surely salvation is near those who fear him, at hand / That glory may be dwelling in the midst of our land
Mercy and truth meet; righteousness and peace embrace / Truth springs out of earth; righteousness looks down from heaven’s place
Yahweh gives what is good; our land will bear fruit / Righteousness goes before him, preparing his route
Hear, Yahweh, answer me; poor, needy, hear my plea / Preserve my soul; I’m godly; save your servant trusting thee
All day I call, lift up my soul; let joy resound / Your goodness, pardon, loving kindness all abound
Hear my prayer; listen to the voice of my plea / In trouble, I call on you; you answer me
No god compares; wondrous deeds proclaim your fame / All nations you have made will worship, praise your name
Teach me your way of truth; unite my heart, O Lord / I’ll praise and glorify your name forevermore
Your loving kindness toward me runs so very deep / From the lowest Sheol, you have set my soul free
Proud, violent men seek my soul; they hold you in disregard / But you, Lord, show mercy, grace, slow anger, love and truth impart
Turn, show mercy; strengthen your servant, save his son today / Let haters see your sign, be shamed: your help and comfort displayed
His foundation is there in the holy mountains / Yahweh loves Zion’s gates more than all Jacob’s dwellings
Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God / Rahab, Babylon I record among those acknowledging me
Philistia, Tyre, Ethiopia: “This one was born there” / Of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her”
The Most High himself, he will establish her / Yahweh will count, writing them up: “This one was born there”
Those who sing as well as those who dance, they say / “All of my springs, they are all of them in you”
Yahweh, God of salvation, receive my plea / By day and night I cry; turn your ear to me
My soul is full of troubles; Sheol now draws near / Counted with all those going down, no help is here
Set apart with the dead, like slain ones remembered no more / Cut off from your hand; you laid me in the pit’s darkest core
Your wrath it lies heavy on me; your waves press me low / You took friends, made me vile to them; I’m confined, no way to go
Grief dims my eyes; each day, Yahweh, I call to you / And I have also spread out my hands to you too
Do the dead ones then rise up and praise you from the depths down low? / Is love, faith, wonders, righteousness declared in dark below?
At dawn I cry to Yahweh; my prayer comes to you / Why do you reject my soul, hide your face from view?
I am afflicted and near death from my youth; terrors confound / Your fierce wrath sweeps over; your terrors cut me off all around
They surround me like water, engulf me all the day / You put lover and friend far; my friends in darkness stay
I’ll sing Yahweh’s love forever, for every age to hear / His faithfulness to every generation I make clear
His love stands firm forever, unshaken through the years / His faithfulness in heaven shines through the spheres
Yahweh swore to David: his offspring would endure / His throne he’d build through generations, steadfast and sure
The heavens praise Yahweh’s wonders, his faithfulness proclaim / The holy ones proclaim your faithfulness by name
No heavenly being matches Yahweh; none can compare / Awesome, feared by all within the council there
He rules the proud sea, calms its waves as they rise high / With mighty arm he scatters foes beneath the sky
All heaven, earth, and all they hold are Yahweh’s domain / He founded them, the world and all its fullness they contain
Tabor and Hermon sing his name, rejoicing with delight / His hand is strong, exalted far above, in might
Righteousness and justice uphold his royal seat / His lovingkindness and his truth go before his feet
Blessed are the people who acclaim him with praise / They walk within the light of his presence all their days
Yahweh said, “I found my servant David, whom I chose” / “With holy oil I anointed him,” as the vision shows
No foe will tax or oppress him, no wicked hand prevail / I’ll beat his foes before him; his haters shall fail
My faithfulness and lovingkindness with him will stay / In my name his horn will rise, exalted in its day
He’ll call, “You are my Father, my God,” in prayer / “The rock of my salvation,” he will declare
I’ll make him firstborn, highest king on earth to rule / My covenant with him will hold, steadfast and true
If David’s children forsake my law and go astray / I’ll punish sin with rod and stripes if they disobey
I won’t remove my lovingkindness, nor let faithfulness fail / I won’t break my covenant; my spoken word prevails
His throne will stand before Yahweh like the sun at dawn / Like moon, a faithful witness, fixed till time is gone
You’ve spurned your anointed, your anger clearly shown / Your servant’s covenant renounced, his crown cast down below
His strongholds lie in ruins; his enemies rejoice / You turned his sword’s edge back, gave no aid in battle’s noise
“How long, Yahweh? Remember my time is short, you see / What man escapes the grave, from Sheol’s power set free?”
“Lord, where are mercies sworn to David, faithful, long ago? / I bear mighty peoples’ taunts; they mock your anointed steps below.”
Lord, through generations, our dwelling place You’ve been / Before the mountains formed, You were God, and still remain
You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, children of men” / A thousand years are yesterday, or a night watch then
You sweep them off as sleep descends into the night / Like grass, they sprout at dawn, then wither by twilight
Your anger consumes us; hidden sins lie in Your light / Our days pass in Your wrath; our years end as a sigh
Seventy or eighty years bring labor, grief, and pain / They swiftly pass us by, then we all fly away
Who knows Your anger’s power, Your wrath, the fear You’re due? / Teach us to count our days, that wisdom may accrue
Relent, Yahweh—how long? Have compassion on Your servants, we pray / Satisfy us with love at dawn; rejoice, be glad all our days
Make us glad for days afflicted, for the evil years we’ve seen / Let Your work appear to servants; glory to their children; establish our hands
Who dwells in the Most High’s secret place rests in the Almighty’s shade / I’ll say Yahweh, my refuge, my fortress, my God; my trust is laid
He frees you from the fowler’s snare and deadly pestilence / His feathers cover; beneath His wings, faithfulness shields your defense
Fear not the terror by night, nor the arrow by day / Nor plague that walks in darkness, nor destruction at midday
A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right / You’ll see the wicked’s recompense; danger won’t draw nigh
Yahweh is your refuge; the Most High is where you stay / No evil shall befall you; no plague will come your way
He puts his angels in charge, to guard you where you roam / They bear you up in their hands so your foot won’t strike a stone
You tread on the lion and cobra, bringing both down / The young lion and serpent you trample to the ground
Because he loves me, knows my name, I’ll deliver, set him high / Calls; answer, stay through trouble; grant long life, honor, salvation show
