It is good to praise Yahweh’s name, Most High, in song / At dawn proclaim his love; by night his faithfulness rings strong
Your works make me glad, Yahweh; I triumph in deeds / How great are your works, Yahweh; your thoughts are deep indeed
Though wicked flourish like grass, they’re destroyed forever / The senseless don’t know; fools can’t understand, however
Yahweh stands exalted, forever on high / His enemies all perish, in ruins they lie
Evildoers scatter, dispersed far and wide / Yahweh lifts my horn like the wild ox, raised high
Fresh oil anoints me; I see and I hear foes rise / The righteous flourish like palms; Lebanon’s cedars reach high
Planted in Yahweh’s house, in our God’s courts they thrive / In old age, full of sap, still green, their fruit will show
Their fruit shows Yahweh upright, his nature is pure / He is my rock; no unrighteousness dwells there
Yahweh reigns, with majesty in robes arrayed / Yahweh is armed with strength, his might displayed
The world is established, fixed, unmoved as can be / Your throne is established long ago; you are from eternity
The floods, they lift up their voice, Yahweh, they cry / The floods lift up their waves, they rise up high
Above the voices of many waters, breakers of the sea / Yahweh on high is mighty, and mighty as can be
Yahweh’s statutes stand firm; their words remain sure / Holiness adorns his house, and shall endure
Yahweh, God of vengeance, shine; rise, judge all the earth / Pay back the proud for what their deeds will be worth
How long will wicked triumph, arrogant and loud? / They pour arrogant words; evildoers boast aloud
Your people they break in pieces; your heritage they strike / They kill the widow and alien, fatherless alike
They say, “Yah won’t see or consider”; fools, when will you be wise? / He made ear and eye; hears and sees, knows each man; nations he’ll chastise
Yahweh knows the thoughts of man are futile, all in vain / Blessed is the one you discipline, whom your law will train
Your law gives rest through hard days till the wicked’s pit is dug / Yahweh won’t forsake his own; the upright follow what is right
Who rises for me against the wicked, comes to my aid? / Without Yahweh’s help, my soul in silence would have stayed
When I said, “My foot slips,” your kindness held me upright / Amid my many thoughts, your comforts brought delight
Can wicked thrones share fellowship with you, legislate deceit? / Against the righteous they meet, condemn the innocent blood
Yahweh has been my high tower, my refuge-rock, my stone / He brings their own iniquity on them, cuts them off, each one
Come sing to Yahweh; shout aloud to the Rock of salvation / Come praise him with songs; lift voices in celebration
Come before him with thanks; extol him in songs of praise / Yahweh, great God and King above all gods, who reigns
The depths and mountain heights are held within his hand / The sea is his; his hands formed the dry land
Come worship, bow, and kneel before Yahweh, our Maker / He made us; let our knees bow low, our Maker be adored
He is our God; his pasture’s people, his own flock / We are the sheep he holds, protected by our Rock
Today, hear his voice; don’t harden your hearts and turn away / As at Massah and Meribah, in the wilderness that day
Fathers tested me, saw my work, and erred in their hearts those days / For forty years I was grieved with them; they knew not my ways
In wrath I swore that their entry would be denied / They would not enter my rest; my word would stand verified
All the earth, sing Yahweh’s new song; bless his name / From day unto day, his salvation proclaim
Declare his glory among nations, works among peoples; proclaim / Yahweh is great, greatly praised; above all gods, fear his name
Among the peoples, gods are idols; Yahweh made the skies / Honor, majesty before him; sanctuary strength and beauty lie
Families of nations, ascribe Yahweh glory and strength / Give glory due his name; bring offerings, enter his courts
Say among nations, Yahweh reigns; world securely stands / He will judge all peoples with equity in his hands
Let the heavens be glad; and let earth rejoice all around / The sea roars with all its fullness, rolling out its sound
Let the field and all that is in it exult and rejoice / Before Yahweh, the trees of the woods lift their joyful voice
Yahweh comes, he comes to judge the earth; his judgment is true / He judges the world with righteousness, the peoples with truth
Yahweh reigns; let earth rejoice, its gladness running free / Let island multitudes be glad, and glad let them be
Clouds and darkness circle him, his throne stands set in stone / Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne
Fire goes before him, burns his foes on every side / His lightning lights the world; earth sees and trembles outright
Mountains melt like wax as Yahweh now draws near / The Lord of the whole earth is present here
The heavens declare his righteousness on high / All peoples have seen his glory with their eyes
Let all who serve engraved images, boast in idols, know shame / Worship him, all of you gods; Yahweh’s glory do proclaim
Love Yahweh, hate evil; he keeps saints from wicked hand / Light’s sown for righteous; gladness fills upright hearts throughout the land
Sing Yahweh a new song for the wonders he’s wrought / His right hand and holy arm have salvation brought
Yahweh has made his salvation clearly known / His righteousness has been before the nations shown
He kept Israel in mind; his love and faith stayed true / The ends of earth have seen God's salvation shine through
All earth, make joyful noise; sing praises, lift them high / Burst out and sing for joy; let praises fill the sky
With harp and voice of melody, sing before the King / Trumpets and ram’s horn sound before Yahweh; let them ring
The sea roars with all its fullness; let it shout / The world and those who dwell therein, let all ring out
The rivers clap their hands; the mountains sing with mirth / They sing for joy before Yahweh, who judges all the earth
He judges the world with righteousness, fair and square / The peoples he judges with equity, just and fair
Yahweh reigns among the cherubim, enthroned / Let all peoples tremble; let the earth be moved
Yahweh is great in Zion, high above all peoples / Let them praise Your great and awesome name; He is Holy
The King’s strength loves justice; You establish what’s right / In Jacob You execute justice and righteousness outright
At the footstool of Yahweh, worship; bow down low / Exalt Yahweh our God; raise His name on high
Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel called / They called on Yahweh, and He answered them all
Yahweh spoke to them from the pillar of cloud / They kept His testimonies, the statute He gave
You answered them, Yahweh our God, and forgave / Though You took vengeance for their doings, You forgave
At His holy hill, exalt Yahweh and bow / Worship Yahweh our God; His holiness we know
All lands, shout for joy to Yahweh; serve him with cheer / Come before his presence with singing; draw near
Know Yahweh, he is God; it is he who made us, we're his / We are his people, the sheep of his pasture; we're his
Enter his gates with thanksgiving; in his courts, sing / Give thanks to him; bless his name; let praises ring
Yahweh is good; his loving-kindness has no end / His faithfulness to all generations will stand
Of loving kindness and justice, Yahweh, I sing / To You, Yahweh, my praises in song I bring
I’ll carefully live blameless; at home my heart stays clear / I ask, “When will You come to me?”—when will You appear?
I set no vile thing before my eyes to see / I hate faithless men’s deeds; they won’t cling to me
A perverse heart will be far from me, held apart / I have nothing to do with evil; I take no part
I silence the secret slanderer; its whispers fade away / The arrogant and conceited cannot with me stay
My eyes are on the faithful, that with me they may dwell / The one who walks a perfect way will serve me
The deceitful will not dwell within my place / The false speaker will not stand before my face
Each morning I destroy the wicked of the land / From Yahweh’s city, all workers of sin are banned
Hear my prayer, Yahweh; let my cry reach your ear / Don’t hide your face; quickly turn your ear; answer my prayer
My days consume like smoke and fade away / My bones are burned as a torch, burning away
My heart withers like grass; I forget to eat my bread / My bones cling to my skin as groans rise from within
I’m like a pelican in wilderness, an owl of waste places / I watch like a sparrow alone on the housetop
My enemies reproach me throughout the day / They use my name as a curse in all that they say
I eat the ashes like bread, and I mix tears in my drink / Your wrath took me up, cast me away; days like shadows sink
You, Yahweh, remain forever, beyond the passing years / Your renown endures through generations, throughout the years
At the set time, Yahweh, he will show Zion his grace / His servants take pleasure in her stones, pity her dust there
Yahweh builds up Zion, appearing in splendor / Nations fear his name; earth’s kings see his grandeur
Yahweh answers the destitute; their prayer he won’t despise / For those to come, this is written; created people praise Yah
From heaven Yahweh looks down on earth from heights on high / He hears prisoners groan, frees those condemned to die
In Zion, they declare his name and praise in Jerusalem / Peoples and kingdoms gather to serve Yahweh with them
You weakened my strength along my course; you shortened my days / My God, don’t take me mid-days; your years span generations
Earth and heavens wear like clothes; you remain the same / Your servants’ children continue, established before you, bearing their name
He forgives all your sins, heals all diseases, redeems your life / Crowns with love; satisfies desire with good, renews youth like eagles
Yahweh does righteous acts, gives oppressed justice outright / To Moses and to Israel, his ways he brought to light
Yahweh is merciful and gracious, anger slow / His loving kindness is abundant; it overflows
He will not accuse forever, nor keep his anger long / He has not dealt with us as sins deserve, nor repaid our wrong
Like a father, Yahweh has compassion for those who fear him / He removes our sins east from west, from us, far from here
He knows we’re dust; like field flowers, we flourish, then are gone / The wind passes over; they’re gone, their place recalls no one
His loving kindness lasts forever for those who fear Yahweh / His righteousness to children’s children, who keep covenant, obey
Yahweh established his throne in heaven to reign / His kingdom rules over all throughout his domain
Angels, praise Yahweh, fulfill his word, obey its voice / His armies serve his pleasure; all works, my soul, praise Yahweh
My soul, bless Yahweh; my God, how great you are / Clothed in honor and majesty beyond compare
He covers himself with light, his garment worn / He stretches out the heavens like a curtain drawn
He lays his chamber beams in waters; clouds bear him there / He makes the clouds his chariot, rides the wind through air
He makes the winds his messengers across the skies / His servants are the flames of fire that rise
He laid earth’s foundations, never moved through time / The deep cloaked it; waters stood above the mountain line
At your rebuke they fled; your thunder drove them away / Mountains rose, valleys sank; your bounds held floods at bay
Springs run through the valleys; beasts drink from the spring / Birds make their nests among the branches and sing
Yahweh waters mountains; green grass and plants grow / Wine, oil, and bread are gifts the earth can bestow
His cedars shelter birds in branches up high / Wild goats climb the mountains; badgers in rock dens lie
The moon marks seasons; sun sets when its hour is due / In darkness, beasts prowl; lions roar, seeking food from you
At sunrise, the lions steal away to their dens / People go out to work till evening ends
His works are made in wisdom; earth’s riches abound / The wide sea holds ships, creatures, Leviathan around
All creatures wait for Yahweh; their needs are supplied / His open hand gives good; they’re satisfied
When he hides his face, they’re troubled; breath withdrawn, they die / He sends his Spirit; they’re created, ground renewed to life
May Yahweh’s glory last; his works his joy evoke / His glance makes earth tremble; his touch makes mountains smoke
I will sing to Yahweh for all of my days / May sinners be consumed; my soul, sing Yahweh’s praise
Give thanks to Yahweh, and call upon his name / Make known his deeds among the peoples; proclaim
Sing to him, sing praises; let the praises ring / Tell of his marvelous works, each wondrous thing
Glory in his holy name; let seekers rejoice / Let the hearts of all who seek Yahweh find joy
Seek Yahweh and his strength; seek his face evermore / Remember his wonders, his marvelous works in store
Remember the judgments that his mouth decreed / Abraham’s offspring, servant; Jacob’s chosen seed
Yahweh is our God; his judgments fill the land / His covenant word through generations will stand
He remembers his covenant through a thousand generations / His oath to Abraham and Isaac; to Jacob, its confirmation
His covenant word to a thousand generations stayed true / To Abraham made, his oath to Isaac; to Jacob confirmed too
To Israel an everlasting covenant, Canaan their inheritance / Few foreigners in the land, they moved from kingdom to kingdom in their wandering
They went from nation to nation, from kingdom to kingdom / He let no one do them wrong; kings heard his warning
He let no one wrong them; rebuked kings for their sake / “Touch not my anointed; my prophets, no harm shall you make”
He called for famine; food supplies were drained / Joseph was sold as a slave, and then chained
Shackled and bound in irons, Joseph waited still / Till Yahweh’s word proved true, just as he said it will
The king freed him, lord of his house, and ruler of all / He disciplined princes, taught elders wisdom at will
He made all his people stronger than foes, growing in might / He turned their hearts to hate, against his servants to fight
He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron whom he chose / They worked signs and wonders in Ham, as the plagues arose
He sent the darkness; they did not rebel against his word / Waters turned to blood; their fish died as he stirred
Frogs filled the rooms in the palaces of kings / Flies and lice came; hail and lightning struck everything
He struck vines and fig trees; shattered country’s trees / Locusts ate plants and fruit, without number, as they pleased
He struck the firstborn, the first fruits of manhood there / He brought them out with silver and gold; not one was weak or frail
Egypt was glad when they left, fearing their might / He spread a cloud for covering, fire to light the night
They asked him; he brought quails, and satisfied them with sky-bread / He opened the rock; its waters, a river, through dry places spread
He remembered his holy word, Abraham his servant; brought them with joy / His chosen sang; he gave them lands, to keep his laws, not destroy
Praise Yahweh, give thanks, for he is good and kind / His loving-kindness lasts forever, through all time
Who can utter Yahweh’s mighty acts and tell them well? / Who fully can declare all praise? Who can tell?
Blessed are those who keep justice, doing what is right / Blessed is one who does what is right at all times
Remember me with favor, Yahweh; grant salvation / Let me see your chosen prosper, rejoice with your nation
We sinned with our fathers, did wickedness and wrong / Our fathers missed Egypt's wonders, forgot love, rebelled at sea
For his name’s sake he saved them, made his great power known / He rebuked the sea, dried it; through depths he led them on
He redeemed them from the hand of foes and enemies / The waters covered their foes; not one remained; they praised
They soon forgot all his works, and did not wait for his counsel / They gave in to craving in the desert, tested God in wasteland
He gave them their request, but leanness filled their soul / They envied Moses and Aaron, Yahweh’s saintly one
They envied Moses and Aaron in the camp / Earth swallowed Dathan; fire burned the wicked in their camp
They made and worshiped a calf, a molten image cast / They traded their glory for a bull that ate the grass
They forgot God their Savior, who worked wonders in Egypt’s land / Wonders in Ham and awesome things by the Red Sea, by his hand
You said you’d destroy them; Moses stood in the breach / He turned away your wrath, kept destruction out of reach
They despised the pleasant land, did not believe your word / They murmured in their tents, did not heed Yahweh's voice
At Baal Peor they joined, ate sacrifices of the dead / Phinehas judged; plague stopped; to him righteousness was credited
At Meribah, they angered Yahweh; Moses was distressed / They rebelled against his spirit; rash words he expressed
Though Yahweh commanded, they spared the peoples, let them stay / They mixed with nations, learned their works; idols ensnared them there
To demons they sacrificed their daughters and their sons / They shed innocent blood; Canaan’s land was stained by the ones
Your anger burned; you gave them to the nations’ sway / Their foes ruled them, oppressed them; they bowed beneath their hand
You rescued them many times; they rebelled in their counsel / Their iniquity brought them low; their sin became their downfall
You heard them in distress, when they cried out in their need / You remembered covenant, relented in love and kindness
You made their captors pity them; your kindness came to mind / You made them pitied by those who held them captive
Save us, Yahweh; gather us from nations far and wide / So we may thank your holy name, in your praise take pride
Blessed be Yahweh, Israel’s God, forever and evermore / Let all the people say, “Amen,” and praise Yahweh as before
Give thanks, Yahweh is good; his love endures always / Let all redeemed by Yahweh sing out his praise
From east, west, north, and south, he gathers from the lands / He rescues the redeemed from the adversary’s hands
They wander desert paths; no city can they find / Hungry and thirsty, their souls grow faint deep inside
They cry to Yahweh; he delivers them from plight / He leads them by a straight way, to a city in sight
He satisfies the longing soul with all that’s good / He fills the hungry soul with good
Some sat in darkness, death’s shadow, bound in iron chains / They rebelled against God’s words, condemned Most High’s counsel with disdain
Their hearts are bowed by labor; they fall beneath the strain / No one is there to help them rise up through the pain
He saves them from distress and draws them from the night / He breaks their chains and brings them out of death’s shadowed plight
He shatters bronze gates, breaking them apart / He cuts through iron bars that held them in their dark
Fools suffer for disobedience, their iniquities a blight / They loathe all food; death’s gates come into sight
They cry to Yahweh; he delivers from their graves / He sends his word to heal them, and he saves
Let them offer thanksgiving’s sacrifice in song / Declare his deeds with singing, let the praise ring strong
Those trading in ships on great waters see wonders in the deep / He commands the storm, and its waves across them sweep
The waves rise to the sky, then sink to depths below / Their souls melt; at their wits’ end, they stagger to and fro
They cry to Yahweh; he brings them out of distress / He calms the storm and stills the waves, giving rest
Then they are glad because it is calm; they reach the haven they sought / Let them praise him in assembly with elders, for all he wrought
For wickedness, rivers turn to desert, springs to thirsty ground / He makes fruitful lands salt wastes; dry lands to pools and springs abound
The hungry build a city, sow fields and plant vines to grow / And they reap the fruits of increase from the seeds that they sow
He blesses them; they multiply, their livestock do not wane / Then troubles bow them down; scorned princes roam the trackless plain
He lifts the needy from distress; their families grow / The upright rejoice; the wicked hush; the wise consider Yahweh’s kindness and know
My heart is steadfast, God; my soul will sing and play / Wake up, harp and lyre; I’ll wake the dawn today
I thank you, Yahweh, among nations; sing praise among peoples wide / Your loving kindness great above heavens; faithfulness reaches skies
Be exalted, God, above the heavens on high / Let your glory cover all the earth beneath the sky
With your right hand, save your beloved; set them free / Answer us, God, and attend unto our plea
God speaks from his sanctuary: “In triumph I will divide / Shechem, and measure Succoth’s valley out wide”
Gilead and Manasseh mine; Ephraim my helm, Judah’s rod / Moab my washpot; sandal on Edom; shout o’er Philistia abroad
Who’ll bring me to the stronghold? Who has led me to Edom? / Have you rejected us, God? You don’t go out with our fighting men
Give us help against enemy; man’s help cannot overcome foe / Through God we’ll act with valor; he will tread our enemies low
God of my praise, don’t remain silent; hear my plea; / The wicked speak deceit and lies against me.
They fight me without cause, repaying love with hate; / They give me evil for my good; in prayer I wait.
Set a wicked man over him; an adversary at his right; / When judged, let him come out guilty, found in the wrong outright.
Let his days be few; let his lifetime not last long; / Let another take his office when he is gone.
Let his children be fatherless; his wife a widow alone; / Let them roam as beggars, searched in the ruins they call home.
Let creditors seize all he has; strangers plunder what he made; / Let none show kindness to him, nor his fatherless children aid.
Cut off his posterity; let their name from earth be gone; / Let fathers’ guilt and mother’s sin before Yahweh remain.
He showed no kindness; pursued the poor and needy in need; / The brokenhearted too, to kill them—that was his deed.
He loved the curse; it clothed him like a coat he wore; / Like water in his inward parts, like oil deep in his core.
This is the reward from Yahweh for foes who speak against my soul; / For your name, Yahweh, deal with me; your kindness, set me free.
Poor and needy, my heart is wounded; I fade away; / Like evening shadow, like a locust shaken away.
My fasting weakens both my knees and thins my frame; / I’ve become a reproach; they shake their heads when seen.
Save me, Yahweh, by your kindness; let them know your hand; / They curse, but you bless; they rise shamed, your servant glad.
I give great thanks to Yahweh in the crowd; I praise his name; / He stands at needy's right hand, saves him from those who judge his soul.
Yahweh tells my Lord, “Sit at my right hand; take your seat” / Till foes are made a footstool for the soles of your feet
Yahweh sends from Zion the rod of your strength, from the land / Rule among your enemies; there take your stand
On power’s day, his people offer in holy array / From morning’s womb, he has youth’s dew at break of day
Yahweh has sworn; his mind he will not change, ever / In Melchizedek’s order, you are a priest forever
The Lord is at your right hand and standing near / He crushes kings when the day of his wrath is here
He judges nations, heaps dead bodies on the ground / He crushes the ruler of the whole earth down
He drinks from the brook as he travels on his way / Therefore he lifts up his head as he goes on his way
I thank Yahweh with my whole heart among the upright / In council and congregation, I praise him outright
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all who delight / His work is honor and majesty indeed
His righteousness endures forever, indeed / He caused his wonderful works to be remembered indeed
Yahweh is gracious and merciful indeed / He has given food to those who fear him indeed
He always remembers his covenant; it abides / He shows his people the power his works command
He gives them the heritage of nations by his hand / The works of his hands are truth and justice indeed
All his precepts are sure, established forever / They are done in truth and uprightness, forever
He sent redemption to his people / His covenant he ordained forever
Fear of Yahweh begins wisdom; his name is holy and awesome / All who do his work gain good sense; his praise lasts forever
Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, delights in His commands / His offspring mighty; upright generations blessed in the land
Wealth and riches are in his house, within its walls / His righteousness endures forever, never falls
Light rises for the upright in the dark of night / Gracious, merciful, righteous—the upright shine bright
It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends / He maintains his cause in judgment; his claim stands
For he will never be shaken, standing secure / The righteous will be remembered forevermore
His heart is steadfast, established, trusting Yahweh / He won’t fear evil news; no fear when foes appear
He has dispersed, has given to the poor / His horn, it will be exalted with honor
The wicked see and grieve, their teeth gnashing in dismay / They melt away; each wicked desire will decay
Praise Yah! You servants, you do praise Yahweh’s name / Blessed be his name, forevermore the same
From sunrise to sunset, Yahweh’s name be praised / From the sun’s rising to its setting, praise raised
Yahweh is high above all nations below / His glory above the heavens, it does show
Who is like Yahweh, our God, seated on high? / Who has his seat on high? None is like him—who?
He stoops down to see in the heaven above / And he does look on the earth that is below
He raises the poor out of the dust below / Lifts the needy from the ash heap that is low
He does set them with princes, his people’s own / With the princes of his people, they are shown
He settles the barren woman in her home / As a joyful mother of children, there to roam
Israel went out of Egypt, from a foreign-speaking crowd / From a foreign-tongued crowd, the house of Jacob went out
Judah became God’s sanctuary in the land / Israel became His dominion, under His command
The sea saw it, then it fled, retreating back / The Jordan was driven back, forced from its track
The little hills like lambs, the mountains skipped like rams / You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?
Jordan, why did you turn back? Why did you, sea, flee? / What made you skip, you mountains and hills? Tell me.
Earth, tremble at the presence of the Lord and quake / At the presence of the God of Jacob, earth shake
The rock was turned into a pool of water / The flint was turned into a spring of waters
Not unto us, Yahweh, not to us; give glory to your name / For loving-kindness and your truth, your name we acclaim
The nations ask, “Where is their God?”—their questions rise / Our God is in the heavens, doing what he decides
Silver and gold, made by human hands; their mouths don’t talk / They cannot see or hear or smell; their hands are numb, feet can’t walk
Idol-makers become like the idols they create / All who trust in them will be like them in their state
Israel, trust Yahweh; let Aaron’s house trust too / You who fear Yahweh, trust; he will help and shield you
Yahweh remembers us; he blesses us all / He blesses Israel’s house, Aaron’s, fearers, great and small
May Yahweh increase you and your children again and again / Blessed by Yahweh, who made both; heaven his, earth to men
The dead go down in silence; no songs to Yah they raise / But we will bless Yah now and through all coming days
I love Yahweh; he hears my voice and cries for mercy, / Because he turns His ear, I’ll call while life’s in me.
Death’s cords surrounded me; Sheol’s pains held me down, / I had found trouble and sorrow all around.
I called on Yahweh by name, pleading for aid, / “Yahweh, I beg you: deliver my soul!” I prayed.
Yahweh is gracious and righteous; His mercy shows, / He preserves the simple, saves me when I’m brought low.
Return, my soul, to rest; Yahweh dealt well with me, / I’m your servant, servant girl's son; from chains you set me free.
From death he saved my soul, my eyes from tears, my feet from falling down, / I’ll walk before Yahweh in the land where the living are found.
I believed and said, “I was greatly afflicted,” / In haste, “All people are liars,” I predicted.
What can I give Yahweh for all the good he gave? / I take salvation’s cup and call on Yahweh’s name.
Saints’ death is precious in Yahweh’s sight; vows I pay before them, / I offer thanksgiving sacrifice in Yahweh’s courts, Jerusalem.
All you nations, praise Yahweh; proclaim his fame / All you peoples, extol him; honor his name
His loving-kindness toward us is great indeed / Yahweh’s faithfulness endures, will not recede
Yahweh is good; His loving kindness will remain / Israel, Aaron’s house, all fearing say it stays the same
In deep distress I called to Yah, raised my plea / And Yah, he answered me, and he set me free
Yahweh is on my side; no man can make me fear / With those who help, I’ll triumph o’er my haters here
Yahweh is a safer refuge than trusting mortal men / Better than trusting princes; trust in Him, not them
The nations, they swarmed like bees; all around me they came / In Yahweh’s name I cut them off; they’re quenched like thorns aflame
They shoved me hard, intending to cast me down / But Yahweh helped me stand and hold my own ground
Yah is my strength and song; He has become my Savior / The righteous tents ring joy; His right hand acts with valor
Yah punished me severely, but kept me alive / I will not die, but live; His works I will describe
Open the righteous gates for me; I enter, give thanks today / This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous enter this way
The builders cast the stone aside; the cornerstone’s in place / Yahweh, he has done this; marvelous before our face
This is the day, the day that Yahweh has made / We will rejoice and be glad in it today
Yahweh, save us now; send prosperity now, we do pray / Blessed he who comes in Yahweh’s name; from His house we bless you today
Yahweh is God; He gave the light; the offering is tied / You are my God; I thank, exalt You; Your kindness won’t subside
Blessed are the blameless who walk in Yahweh’s way / They seek him with whole hearts, his statutes obey
I long for steadfast ways; let my feet not stray / I’ll keep your statutes; don’t forsake me, I pray
I have hidden your word in my heart, deep within / So that I might not sin against you again
A stranger on earth; don’t hide your commands from me / My soul longs for your ordinances endlessly
Though princes slander me, I meditate on your ways / Your statutes delight me; they counsel always
Laid low in the dust, worn down by sorrow’s weight / By your word, revive me; strengthen me, I pray
I choose the way of truth, set your laws in view / I run the path of commands, for you set my heart free
The wicked’s ropes bind me, my steps held tight / Yet I won’t forget Yahweh’s law through the night
Before affliction, I wandered astray / Now I observe your word and obey what you say
Yahweh’s spoken law is worth far more than gold / More than thousands of silver, its value untold
Like a wineskin in the smoke, I shrivel and dry / I will not forget your statutes, though withered am I
The proud dug pits; they nearly wiped me from the land / Yet I did not forsake your precepts; I still stand
Your word is settled in heaven, firm forevermore / Your faithfulness keeps the earth established at its core
Your promises taste sweeter than honey’s delight / Your word lights my feet and my path with its light
The wicked lay a snare, but I hold on fast / Your testimonies are my joy that will last
My flesh trembles in fear before your judgments’ might / Your testimonies are my heritage, my heart’s delight
They break your law; it is time to act, Yahweh / Your commands I love more than pure gold, I say
Streams of tears run from my eyes; they ignore your law / Your upright judgments and righteous statutes have no flaw
Though small and despised, I keep your precepts each day / Your righteousness lasts; your law is truth always
Yahweh is near, and I rejoice in his word / Like one who finds great plunder, my joy is stirred
In my distress, I called to Yahweh with a cry / Yahweh heard me as I called, then sent reply
Yahweh, free me from lips that speak out their lies / And free me from tongues that wear deceit’s disguise
What will be given to you, what more done, deceitful tongue? / Sharp arrows of the mighty, juniper coals too
Woe is me, I live in Meshech, here I stay / I am dwelling among the tents of Kedar there
My soul has dwelt too long with one who hates peace / I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war
I lift my eyes toward hills, and ask where help is found; / My help comes from Yahweh, who made the sky and ground.
He will not allow your foot to be moved at all; / The one who keeps you does not slumber at all.
Yahweh is your keeper and your shade at your right hand; / He keeps Israel, neither slumbers nor sleeps across the land.
The sun by day will not bring harm, shining bright; / Nor will the moon’s light bring harm to you at night.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil and harm; / He will keep your soul, and guard it from harm.
He will keep your going out and your coming in; / From this time forward, his keeping will not end.
They said, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”—I was glad inside / Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem
Jerusalem is built compact, a close-knit town / Where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, Israel’s own
By the ordinance for Israel, they go up / They give thanks to Yahweh’s name, lifting it up
Thrones for judgment are established in their place / The thrones belong to David’s house, set there
Pray for peace in Jerusalem; may it thrive / Those who do love you, they will prosper and thrive
May peace within her walls be settled, safe and sound / May prosperity in her palaces abound
For my brothers’ and companions’ sake, I say, “Peace be within you” / For the sake of Yahweh’s house our God, I’ll seek your good anew
I lift my eyes to you, Yahweh, who sits in heaven’s skies / Like servants watch their master’s hand, we wait till mercy arrives
Have mercy on us, Yahweh; have mercy, we plead / We’ve endured so much contempt; it’s mercy we need
Our soul's exceedingly filled with scoffing of those at ease / And the contempt of the proud—our soul is filled with these
Let Israel now say: had Yahweh not been on our side / We'd have been swallowed alive when men rose, defied us
When men rose against us, their anger ran hot / It would have swallowed us alive, spared us not
The waters would overwhelm us, surging and wide / The stream would sweep over our soul like a tide
Blessed be Yahweh, who kept us from their teeth / The proud waters would have gone over our soul beneath
We escaped like a bird from the fowler’s snare / The snare broke; we escaped into open air
Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made the sky / And all the earth below, with heaven on high
Those trusting Yahweh are like Mount Zion, secure / Unmoved, it remains forever, set to endure
As mountains surround Jerusalem, all around its core / Yahweh surrounds his people from now and evermore
The wicked scepter won't stay over the righteous' share / So righteous hands won’t be used to do evil there
Do good, Yahweh, to all of those who are good / To those upright in heart, do good as you should
Yahweh leads those who turn crooked, with workers of sin away / May the peace be upon all of Israel, we do pray
When Yahweh brought back those returned to Zion, we were like dreamers / Then our mouths filled with laughter, our tongues filled with singing
Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad / Among the nations they said, “Great things for them!”—they said
Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, we implore / Like streams in the Negev, restore us once more
Those who sow in tears will reap with joy at harvest’s end / He goes out weeping, seed in hand; with sheaves he’ll come again
Unless Yahweh builds the house, its builders’ work will fail, / Unless he watches o’er the city, guards’ work won’t avail.
You rise up early, stay up late, and eat toil’s bread, / It’s vain; he gives his loved ones sleep instead.
Behold, the children are Yahweh’s heritage, / The fruit of the womb is his reward, as well.
Children of one’s youth are arrows for a man, / Like arrows held in a mighty warrior’s hand.
Happy is the man whose quiver’s full of them, / They speak with foes at the gate and won’t be shamed.
Blessed are all who fear Yahweh, walk in His ways / You eat the fruit of your hands, your heart at ease
Your wife, a fruitful vine, deep within your house is found / Your children, olive plants, ring the table round
May Yahweh bless you from Zion throughout your days / May Jerusalem’s good be yours to see always
May you see your children’s children throughout your life / May peace be upon all Israel, free from strife
Let Israel say: They afflicted us many times from youth / Yet they have never prevailed against us, in truth
The plowers with their plows went down across our backs / They made long furrows, stretching out in deep tracks
Yahweh is righteous; He has done what is right / He cut apart the cords the wicked held tight
May those who hate Zion find their hopes denied / May they be disappointed, turned backward aside
May they be like the grass upon the housetops / That withers before it grows up and then stops
No reaper can fill his hand with grass to reap / No binder gathers it against his breast to keep
Those passing by don’t say, “Yahweh’s blessing be on you” / Nor, “We bless you in Yahweh’s name,” as they pass through
From the depths I cry to Yahweh; hear my plea / Lord, do hear my voice; incline your ear to me
If Yah kept a record of sins, who could stand here? / But forgiveness is with you, Lord, and you are feared
I hope in his word; my soul waits; I wait for Yahweh / My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen for the day
Israel, hope in Yahweh; loving kindness is with him / Abundant redemption; he’ll redeem Israel from all their sins
My heart is not proud; I don't gaze up too high / Great matters and wonders too high, I pass them by
I've stilled, quieted my soul, like a weaned child by his mother's side / Israel, all of you, hope in Yahweh; let that hope abide
Yahweh, remember David and all his pain, / He swore to Yahweh, vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob.
David vowed he’d not enter his house, nor go to bed, / Nor let sleep touch his eyes till Yahweh’s dwelling he found.
We heard it in Ephrathah; in Jaar’s field it was found, / We’ll worship at his footstool; arise, Yahweh, with your ark to rest.
For David’s sake, don’t turn his anointed’s face away, / Yahweh swore David’s own seed on his throne would stay.
Yahweh chose Mount Zion, desired it for his own, / “My resting place forever; here I will make my home.”
He’ll bless her provision, satisfy her poor with bread, / Her priests he’ll clothe with salvation; her saints shout aloud for joy.
And he will make David’s horn put forth its buds and grow, / And he will ordain a lamp for his anointed to glow.
He’ll clothe his enemies in shame, / His anointed’s crown will shine, a radiant sight.
Precious oil runs down Aaron’s head and beard to robes, / Hermon’s dew comes down on Zion’s hills below.
Yahweh’s servants stand by night within his house / Look! Praise Yahweh, all servants who serve through the night
In the sanctuary, they lift their hands on high / They praise Yahweh, as the lifted hands testify
From Zion, may Yahweh bless you, maker of sky and land / He made heaven and earth; may Yahweh bless you all
Praise Yah, praise Yahweh’s name, you servants in his courts / Yahweh is good; sing praise, for his name is pleasant
Yahweh selected Jacob for himself, his own / Israel, the possession that was his alone
Yahweh stands above all gods, exalted on high / He does what he pleases in earth, sea, depths, and sky
He raises the clouds; with rain, the lightning pours / He brings forth wind from his treasuries’ stores
Egypt’s firstborn he struck, both human and beast / On Pharaoh and servants, signs and wonders released
He struck many nations; killed Sihon, Og, kings of the land / To Israel he gave as heritage all Canaan’s land
His name endures forever; his renown through generations / Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants
Gold and silver idols, work of hands, can’t speak or see / They can’t hear; makers and trusters become like these
Israel, Aaron, Levi, all who fear Yahweh, give praise / Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, Jerusalem where he stays
Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is truly good / His loving-kindness endures forevermore
Give thanks to the God of gods; his kindness endures / Give thanks to the Lord of lords; his love lasts always
He alone does such great wonders, beyond compare / By understanding, he made the heavens there
He spread out the earth above the waters below / He made the great lights, with their order to show
The sun rules by day, shining in its own light / And the moon and the stars, they do rule through the night
He struck down Egypt’s firstborn; Israel he brought away / With a strong hand and outstretched arm, he led them on their way
He divided the Red Sea, its waters drawn wide / Israel passed through the middle, to the other side
Pharaoh and his army were overthrown in the sea / He led his people through wilderness, set free
He struck down great kings, mighty kings in their place / Sihon and Og, they were brought down by his grace
He gave their land to Israel, his servant, as heritage / He remembered us low and delivered us from our foes
He gives food to every creature, sustaining them all / Give thanks to the God of heaven, whose kindness won’t fall
By Babylon’s rivers, we sat down and wept / We remembered Zion, the place we had left
We hung our harps on willows in that captive land / Our tormentors demanded joy: “Sing us Zion’s song!”—command
How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a land that is foreign? / If I forget you, Jerusalem, let right hand forget its skill
Let my tongue stick to my mouth’s roof if I forget you / If I don’t prize you above my chief joy of all
Yahweh, remember Edom; they urged Jerusalem’s destruction / And Edom did cry, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
Daughter of Babylon, doomed; destruction will come / Happy is he who repays you as you have done to us
Happy, he takes her little ones to the rock / Then he dashes them against that solid block
I thank you with my whole heart; gratitude is sincere / Before the gods, I sing your praise for you to hear
I bow toward your temple, thanking your Name for love / Your Name and Word you have exalted high above
When I called out, you answered my cry / Your strength encouraged my soul from inside
All kings across the earth give thanks when words ring clear / The words that came from your mouth, all kings did hear
They sing of Yahweh’s own ways, their songs acclaim / His glory is great, and they sing of his fame
Though Yahweh is high, he looks after those down low / He knows the proud, however far they may go
Though I walk through trouble, you revive me despite strife / You stretch your hand against their wrath and save my life
Yahweh fulfills my concerns; loving kindness endures forever / Don’t forsake the works of your own hands, O Yahweh, ever
Yahweh searches, knows my sitting, rising, thoughts, and ways / Each word upon my tongue is known, each spoken phrase
You hem me in before, behind; you lay your hand / This knowledge is too lofty for me to understand
Where could I flee your Spirit, find a place to hide? / In heaven or in Sheol, you are there beside
If I take dawn’s wings, settle at the farthest sea / Your hand will lead me there, your right hand holding me
I say, “Darkness will overwhelm; my light will be night” / Yet night shines as the day; no dark hides from your sight
You formed and knit me in the womb, shaping my frame / I thank you: fearfully and wonderfully made
Your eyes saw my frame, woven in the earth’s depths below / The days ordained were in your book before they showed
Your thoughts, how precious! Their sum outnumbers grains on shore / When I wake, I am still with you as before
And they speak against you; the foes take in vain your name / If only, God, you’d kill the wicked; leave me, bloodthirsty men
Yahweh, I hate those who hate you, grieved when they oppose / I hate them with perfect hatred; they have become my foes
Search me, God; know my heart; test me; know my thoughts, I pray / See if wicked way’s in me; lead me in everlasting way
Deliver me, Yahweh, from evil men and violent men, / They gather for war, devising mischief again.
They sharpen their tongues like serpents, poised to bite, / Viper’s poison lies beneath their lips, held tight.
Keep me from wicked hands that aim to trip my feet, / The proud spread cords, nets, snares along the path in wait.
I said, “You are my God”; Yahweh, hear my plea, / Listen to the cry of my petitions; hear me.
Yahweh, my saving strength, protects me in the fray, / You cover up my head upon the battle’s day.
Do not grant wicked hearts the things they desire, / Nor let their plans succeed, or pride will climb still higher.
Let their own lips’ mischief cover them; let burning coals fall, / Cast them in fire and miry pits, from which they never rise at all.
Yahweh upholds afflicted, gives needy justice and right, / The righteous thank Your name; the upright dwell in Your sight.
Yahweh, I have called on you; come quickly, hear my plea / Listen to my voice when I call to you; hear me
My prayer is set before you, like incense in the air / I lift my hands like evening’s sacrifice in prayer
Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth; guard my lips with care / Don’t incline my heart to evil; shun their deeds and fare
Let the righteous strike me; kindness, reproof like oil on my head / Don’t let my head refuse it; my prayer’s against evil deeds instead
Their judges are thrown down beside the rock, laid low / They’ll hear my words, for they are well spoken aloud
Our bones are scattered at Sheol’s mouth on the ground / Like earth broken by the plow, the furrows split around
My eyes fixed on Yahweh, Lord; in you I take refuge there / Do not leave my soul destitute; do not leave it bare
Keep me from the snare and traps the workers of evil lay / The wicked fall in their own nets as I pass by
I cry to Yahweh for mercy as I pray / My troubles and complaint before Him I lay
When my spirit was overwhelmed, You knew my way / They hid a snare along the path where I walk each day
Look to my right and see: no one is there to care / Refuge fled from me; no one cares for my soul anywhere
You are my refuge, Yahweh, my portion and share / In the land of the living, my portion is there
Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need / Deliver me; my persecutors surpass my strength indeed
Bring my soul out of prison and grant me release / That I may give my thanks to Your name with praise
The righteous will gather and circle around me / For You will be good and kind to me, You will be
Hear my prayer, Yahweh; in faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me / No man who is living is ever righteous, as you see
He chases my soul, then strikes me to the floor / He leaves me in the dark, like those dead long before
My spirit is overwhelmed, its strength grown weak / My heart within me is desolate and bleak
I remember days of old; ponder your deeds, the work of your hands / I spread out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like parched lands
Hurry to answer, Yahweh; my spirit fails; don’t hide your face / Lest I become like those who go down into the pit below
Hear your lovingkindness in the morning; in you I trust, I do / Show me the path I ought to walk; I lift my soul to you
Deliver me, Yahweh, from enemies who pursue / I flee to you, that you may hide me from their view
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God / Your Spirit is good; lead me in uprightness
Revive me for your name; in righteousness, lift my soul from distress / I’m your servant; in lovingkindness, cut foes, destroy oppressors
Blessed Yahweh, my rock, my fortress, my stay / You train my hands for war, my fingers for the fray
What is man, that You care, or think of him, at all? / Man is like a breath; his days like shadows fade and fall
Yahweh, part the heavens; come down from on high / Touch mountains till they smoke; send lightning, foes take flight
Reach down Your hand, save me from waters so deep / From foreigners' lying mouths, their right hands deceive
A new song to God on ten-string lyre I sing / You save kings; You rescue David, Your servant, from sword’s sting
Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, standing tall / Our daughters like carved pillars, to adorn the palace hall
Our barns are full; our sheep increase by thousands in herds / No breach, no going out, no street cries can be heard
Happy are the people who live in such a way / Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh
I will exalt You, Yahweh, my God, the King / Each day I’ll praise Your name; forever praise I bring
Your greatness can’t be searched; no mind can fully know / One age tells the next the mighty works You show
I muse on majesty and wonders You display / They voice the memory of goodness, sing Your righteous ways
You’re gracious, merciful, slow to anger, kind to everyone / Your tender mercies rest on every work beneath the sun
All works give thanks; Your saints declare Your kingdom’s reign / They speak its glory and its power, which shall remain
You faithfully uphold all who've fallen to the ground / You will raise up the bowed, and lift all who are bent down
All living things await You; their food You will supply / You open Your hand; their every want You satisfy
You’re righteous, gracious, near to those who call in truth / You fulfill the fearers’ desire, hear their cries, save them too
You keep those who love You; the wicked are swept away / Let all flesh bless Your holy name through endless days
My soul, praise Yahweh; my soul, now give him praise / As long as I live, I’ll sing praise all my days
Trust not in princes, nor in mortals for their aid / Their spirit goes to earth; their thoughts perish that day
Happy is he with the God of Jacob for his aid / His hope is in Yahweh, his God, firmly placed
Yahweh made the heavens, earth, and sea, all they contain / He keeps truth forever; his truth will remain
He gives the oppressed justice, gives the hungry food / Yahweh frees the prisoners; the captives are released
Yahweh opens blind eyes, lifts the bowed up to stand / He loves just; holds stranger, widow, orphan by hand
He will turn the wicked ones’ way completely upside down / Yahweh reigns through all the generations; Zion’s God wears the crown
Praise Yah; to sing to our God is good and right / It is pleasant and fitting to praise him aright
Yah builds Jerusalem, gathers Israel’s outcasts there / He heals the brokenhearted, binds the wounds they bear
He counts each star and he calls them all by their name / Great our Lord, mighty in power; his wisdom has no frame
Yahweh upholds the humble, those bowed low / He brings the wicked down to the ground below
He covers skies with clouds, sends rain; grass grows on mountains tall / He gives livestock food, and feeds young ravens when they call
He takes no pleasure in the horse’s strength or man’s legs’ might / Those fearing him, hoping in his loving-kindness, bring delight
He strengthened the bars of your gates, blessed your children within / He makes peace in your borders, fills you with finest wheat to brim
He sends wool-like snow, ash-like frost, pebbled hail below / His word melts them; he sends wind, and waters flow
To Jacob he shows his word; Israel’s statutes are shown / Not done for every nation; his ordinances aren’t known
From heaven’s heights, let all the angels praise the Lord / His heavenly army lifts its song in one accord
Sun, moon, and all the shining stars praise Yahweh / Heavens of heavens, waters above them praise Yahweh
At his command, they were created by his hand / He fixed them evermore; his decree will stand
Sea creatures and depths from the earth praise the Lord / Lightning, hail, snow, clouds; storm winds fulfill his word
Mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars join the call / Wild beasts, livestock, small creatures, birds join them all
Kings, peoples, princes, judges praise Yahweh on high / Young men, maidens, old men, children magnify
His name alone is exalted over earth and sky / His glory is above the heavens and earth on high
He lifts up his people’s horn, their strength he raises / His people, Israel, are near him, giving praise
Praise Yahweh and sing to him a new song of praise / His praise in the assembly of saints they raise
Let Israel rejoice in the Maker who made them / Let Zion be joyful in its King, exult in him
Praise his name in the dance, all dancing in praise / Sing praises with tambourine and harp as they play
Yahweh takes pleasure in his people with delight / He crowns the humble with salvation outright
Let all the saints rejoice in honor; it’s theirs / They sing for joy while they lie upon their beds
High praises of God may be in all of their mouths / A two-edged sword is held in each of their hands
Execute vengeance on nations; punish the peoples / Bind kings with chains, and nobles with iron fetters
Execute on them the written judgment as decreed / All his saints have this honor; praise Yah indeed
Praise God in his sanctuary; lift his praise up high / Praise him in his heavens for acts of power and might
Praise him for his mighty acts, let his works be shown / Praise him for excellent greatness, let it be known
With the trumpet and harp, let his praise now sound / With the lyre as well, let his praises resound
Praise him with the tambourine; dance as you sway / Praise him with the strings and flute; let their music play
Praise him with loud cymbals, their sound filling the air / Praise him with resounding cymbals, let all hear
Let all that draws a breath give praise unto Yah / Praise Yah, let everything that has breath praise Yah!
Solomon’s proverbs school the simple, giving prudence and insight / They deepen wise discernment, teaching justice and what’s right
The fear of Yahweh is where knowledge first takes root / But fools despise instruction; wisdom they refute
My son, keep your father’s teaching, mother’s words held dear / A garland crowns your head; neck-chains you will wear
They tempt him: “Lurk for innocent blood; strike without cause” / “Let’s swallow them like Sheol, whole, into its jaws”
We’ll find riches, fill our homes with plunder to keep / “Cast in your lot with us; one purse, our spoils we will reap”
Don’t walk the path they take; keep clear of their route / Their feet race toward evil, bloodshed their pursuit
A net spread in plain sight won’t catch a bird aware / Their plots spill their own blood and lives; greed lays a snare
Wisdom calls aloud in streets where people meet / Her words ring through squares and gates, from street to street
“How long do simple love folly? Mockers delight in scorn” / “Turn at my reproof; I’ll pour my spirit, make my words known”
“I called, stretched my hand; you refused to pay attention” / “You ignored all my counsel, refused my correction.”
She’ll laugh when disaster sweeps them like a storm / When distress and anguish whirl like a whirlwind’s form
“They’ll call, she won’t answer; seek her, but won’t find” / “They hated knowledge, Yahweh’s fear they had declined”
They eat their own ways’ fruit; by their own schemes they’re filled / Simple backsliding kills; fools’ careless ease leaves them killed
Whoever listens to Wisdom will dwell without fear / At ease, secure from harm, with no danger near
My son, receive these words; store up commands within / Turn your ear to wisdom; let understanding sink in
Call out for discernment; lift your voice in a cry / Seek her as silver; search hidden treasure’s prize
Then understand the fear of Yahweh, draw near / And find the knowledge of God, made plain and clear
Yahweh gives wisdom; his mouth gives knowledge, insight / He stores sound wisdom for the upright, shields those who walk aright
He guards the paths of justice; preserves his saints’ way too / Know righteousness, justice, equity, and what is right to do
Wisdom enters your heart; knowledge delights your soul / Discretion watches; understanding keeps you whole
Wisdom saves from evil men who leave right paths for night / They rejoice in evil; crooked paths are their delight
Wisdom saves from the strange woman; her flattering words mislead / She leaves her youthful friend, gives God’s covenant no heed
Her house leads down to death; her paths lead to the dead / None return from her, nor reach life’s path ahead
So you may walk with good men and keep to the righteous way / Upright and perfect remain; wicked traitors are cut away
My son, don't forget my teaching; keep commands in your heart / They add length of days, years of life, and peace to impart
Bind kindness and truth around your neck to wear / Write them upon your heart; inscribe them right there
Trust Yahweh with your whole heart; don't lean upon your mind / In all your ways acknowledge him; straight paths you'll find
Don't be wise in your own eyes; fear Yahweh, depart from wrong / It brings health to your body, bones nourished and strong
Honor Yahweh with first fruits, bringing increase to him / Barns brim with plenty; wine vats spill over the rim
Don't despise Yahweh's discipline, nor tire of correction / He reproves the son he loves, as fathers show affection
Silver, fine gold, and rubies cannot rival wisdom's worth / No thing you could desire compares with her on earth
Length of days is in her right hand; her left holds riches and honor / Her pleasant ways are peace; her paths are peaceful evermore
She is a tree of life to those who hold her fast / Happy are those who keep her, holding to the last
By wisdom Yahweh founded earth, a steadfast land / By understanding, heaven’s firm foundations stand
Keep sound wisdom and discretion; hold them with care / They give your soul its life, grace for your neck to bear
Your walk is made secure; your foot will not fall / Lie down without fear; sweet sleep comes at nightfall
Don't fear sudden terror, nor wicked ruin when it comes / Yahweh will be your confidence; keeps your foot from being seized
Don't withhold good from your neighbor when you can provide / Don't say, “Come back tomorrow,” when it's there by your side
Don't plot evil against your neighbor, secure beside you / Don't strive with a man without cause; no harm to you did he do
Don't envy the violent; choose none of their ways / Yahweh befriends the upright; gives the humble his grace
Sons, hear his teaching; seek understanding, take sound learning to heart / Do not forsake his own law; heed the words that he imparts
I was my father's tender, only child, in my mother's eyes / My father taught: Keep my words and commands, and live—his advice
Get wisdom, get understanding, though it costs all your goods / Don’t forget; don’t stray from the words my mouth has sent
Esteem her; she will exalt you, lift you to honor’s place / Embrace her; she crowns your head with splendor, garlanded with grace
On straight paths I have led you; your steps will not be slowed / When you run, you will not stumble as you travel that road
Hold fast to instruction; keep her firmly in your hand / Don’t let her go; she is your life, as I command
Do not enter the wicked path; turn from it and go / Avoid it; don’t pass by; turn from evil, say no
They do not sleep unless they do evil, or make someone fall / They eat the bread of wickedness, drink violence like wine
The righteous path is dawn’s first light, growing more and more clear / It shines more and more until the perfect day appears
The wicked way is darkness; they cannot see at all / They don’t know what they stumble over as they fall
Keep sayings in your sight and heart; they bring health to every part / They’re life to those who find them; guard the wellspring of your heart
Put perverse speech and corrupt lips away; look straight ahead / Make level paths; set ways; don't turn right or left; keep foot from evil's tread
Son, heed my wisdom; turn your ear to what I teach; / Preserve discretion; let your lips guard knowledge in speech.
Her lips drip honey, the adulteress speaks; / Her mouth is smoother than oil, its surface sleek.
Her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged blade; / Her feet go down to death; her steps all to Sheol are laid.
Her crooked ways leave the path of life far behind; / She gives no thought to life; her bent ways escape her mind.
Stay far from her door, lest your honor be stripped bare; / Cruel take your years; strangers feast; another home takes its share.
You’ll groan at your latter end as flesh and body waste away; / “I hated instruction, despised reproof,” you’ll say.
Drink from your own cistern, your well’s running clear; / Let springs be for yourself alone, not strangers near.
Rejoice in your wife from youth; let her breasts satisfy; / Be captivated always by her love; hold her tight.
Why captivated by an adulteress, embrace her and stray? / Yahweh examines all your paths; they are before his gaze.
His evil deeds ensnare him; and his sin’s cords hold him fast; / Instruction lacking, he dies; his folly leads him astray at last.
You stand surety for neighbor or stranger, strike hands to seal / By your own mouth’s words you’re ensnared, and now you’re caught for real
Go, humble yourself; press your plea, don’t delay / Give no sleep to your eyes till you’ve broken away
Flee like a gazelle from the hunter, break free / Like a bird from the fowler’s snare, take wing and flee
Go, you sluggard, study the ant’s ways, consider, and grow wise / No chief, overseer, ruler; stores summer bread, harvest supplies
A little sleep brings poverty like a robber at your door / Scarcity comes as an armed man, leaving you poorer
A worthless man speaks perversely, a crooked mouth / He winks; his feet and fingers signal what he’s about
He devises evil, sows discord without cease / Calamity breaks him suddenly, no cure, no release
Yahweh hates proud eyes, lying tongues, hands shed innocent lives / Wicked schemes, swift feet, false witness, and discord that thrives
Keep father’s command, mother’s teaching; bind them in your heart / Tie them continually around your neck; don’t let them depart
The commandment is a lamp; the law’s light can guide / Instruction’s reproofs are the path where life abides
These teachings keep you from the immoral woman’s sway / Her tongue’s flattering words would draw you astray
Don’t lust for her beauty; let not her eyelids catch your eye / Prostitute reduces you to bread; adulteress hunts your life
Can you scoop fire in your lap or walk hot coals unburned? / Touch your neighbor’s wife; the penalty is earned
A hungry thief is not despised if hunger drove the theft / If found, he restores sevenfold, all his house’s wealth
The adulterer lacks sense; he destroys his own soul / Wounds, shame, reproach endure; no cleansing makes him whole
On vengeance day, the jealous husband will not relent / No ransom can content him, though many gifts are sent
Guard my teaching like the apple of your eye, / Write my commands upon your heart; keep them inside.
Call wisdom as your sister; call understanding as your kin, / They’ll keep you from the strange woman who with words that flatter draws you in.
From my window through lattice, I looked outside, / I saw a young man, void of sense, passing by.
Near her corner he passed, then went toward her door, / At twilight, evening, midnight, and darkness—all four.
In a prostitute’s dress, crafty, defiant in her way, / She roams the squares, at every corner lying in wait.
“Peace-offering sacrifices are with me today; / My vows I paid; I sought your face and found you,” she’d say.
Her couch with Egypt’s striped cloth and carpets is spread, / The myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon perfume her bed.
“Love till morning; my husband’s gone on a long journey away; / He took a bag of money; at full moon he’ll return,” she’d say.
Her persuasive words and flattering lips led him astray, / He followed at once, as ox to slaughter, fool in a noose that day.
Like a bird rushing to a snare, not knowing the cost, / An arrow strikes his liver; his life is lost.
My sons, listen; pay attention to what I say, / Don’t let your heart turn; don’t go astray.
She has thrown down many; a host of men fell, / Her house is the way to Sheol, where all of the dead dwell.
From heights where all the paths converge, her voice rings clear / At city gates she calls aloud for all to hear
She calls all humankind: let simple learn prudence, grow wise / You fools, be understanding-hearted; hear her cries
She speaks excellent things and right things; truth she brings / No crooked or perverse thing to her speech ever clings
Her words are plain to those whose understanding is strong / Right to those who find knowledge; they know right from wrong
I, Wisdom, make prudence my dwelling; seek me there / Find knowledge and discretion; seek both with care
To fear Yahweh is to hate evil; pride she despises / Arrogance, evil ways, perverse speech she defies
Counsel and sound knowledge are mine; understanding and might / By me kings reign; princes, nobles rule, and decree what's right
She loves those who love her, returning love in kind / Those who seek her diligently will surely find
Riches, honor, enduring wealth and prosperity flow / She walks in right and justice; her lovers’ stores overflow
Before depths and abundant springs, wisdom was brought to birth / Before the mountains and the hills were set on earth
Yahweh possessed me before his deeds of old began / Set up from everlasting, before the earth's first span
She was the craftsman by Yahweh’s side, rejoicing each day / Rejoicing in his whole world; with sons of men her delight lay
My sons, hear instruction; keep my ways, and be wise / Don't refuse; blessed are those who watch my gates and wait each day
Whoever finds her finds life; Yahweh's favor comes to you / Who sins against her wrongs own soul; her haters love death too
Wisdom built her house; seven pillars carved with care / She prepared meat, mixed wine, and set her table there
From the city heights she calls: “You who are simple, do turn in here!” / Eat bread, drink wine mixed; leave simple ways, live, walk understanding’s way
Reprove a mocker, invite insult; the wicked, abuse / Don’t reprove scoffers, lest they hate; reprove the wise, they’ll love you
Fear of Yahweh begins wisdom, lighting the way / The Holy One’s knowledge is understanding, made clear
By me your days multiply; years increase; if wise, wise for yourself / If you do mock, then you yourself will bear it, and no one else
The foolish, loud, undisciplined woman knows nothing at all / She sits at her house door, on a seat in the city’s heights to call
She says, “Stolen water is sweet,” her words repeat / “Food eaten in secret is pleasant to eat”
The departed spirits are there, but he doesn’t know / Her guests are in the depths of Sheol, far below
A wise son makes his father glad, that’s what is said / A foolish son brings grief to his mother instead
Wicked treasures profit nothing, bring no gain / Righteousness delivers from death; that is plain
Yahweh will not let the righteous soul go hungry or want / He thrusts away the wicked’s desire; he won’t grant
The wise son gathers in the summer, stores the grain / The one who sleeps through harvest brings his household shame
Blessings rest upon the righteous, crown the head / Violence covers wicked mouths, as the proverb said
Many words bring disobedience, sins arise / The one who restrains his lips is surely wise
The rich man’s wealth is like a strong city wall / Poverty brings destruction to the poor, a fall
The labor of the righteous, to life it leads / The increase of the wicked, to sin it leads
Yahweh’s blessing, it brings wealth without distress / The lips of the righteous feed many, nonetheless
What the wicked fear will overtake them, draw near / The desire of the righteous will be granted, made clear
When the whirlwind passes, the wicked vanish away / The righteous stand firm forever, will not sway
False balances are hateful in Yahweh’s sight, / Accurate weights are a source of his delight.
When pride rises high, its shame comes close behind, / Humility brings wisdom into the mind.
Integrity guides the upright along their way, / The treacherous are destroyed by their crookedness outright.
Riches cannot profit when wrath comes to call, / Righteousness delivers from death and its thrall.
Faithless desires ensnare; wickedness drags them low, / When they die, their hope of power ceases to grow.
A godless mouth can destroy the neighbor’s peace, / Through knowledge, the righteous people find release.
The city cheers when righteous fortunes rise, / Upright blessings lift it; wicked speech brings its demise.
Despising your neighbor shows no sense; the wise forbear, / Gossip betrays trust; the trustworthy keep secrets with care.
Without wise guidance, a whole nation falls down, / With many counselors, victory is found.
The merciful do good to their inner selves, / The cruel trouble their flesh, harming themselves.
Scatter, and gain more; water, and get watered in turn, / Withhold grain, earn curses; sell it, blessings return.
A beautiful woman without discretion: gold, / Like a ring in a pig’s snout, grotesque to behold.
The righteous flourish like green leaves that thrive, / The fruit that they bear becomes a tree of life.
The righteous are repaid on earth with their due, / How much more the wicked and sinners face theirs too.
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, eager to learn / Who hates reproof is stupid, too dull to discern
Good people gain Yahweh’s favor; he condemns wicked plans / Wickedness can’t establish; the righteous root stands
A worthy woman is the crown her husband wears / A disgraceful wife is rot his bones must bear
The righteous think justly, and their thoughts are just and fair / Wicked words lie in wait for blood; upright speech saves the snared
The wicked fall and vanish; the righteous house remains / Man praised according to wisdom; warped minds earn disdain
Better little known with a servant than self-praised and breadless / Righteous men respect beasts' lives; wicked mercy's cruel instead
The tiller of land has plenty of bread on hand / The one chasing fantasies cannot understand
Sinful lips trap the evil; the righteous escape the snare / A person is satisfied by mouth-fruit; hands earn their share
A fool thinks his own way is right in his eyes / The wise heed counsel; overlooking insult is wise
Rash words pierce like a sword; wise tongues can ease the pain / Truth stands forever; lies cannot long remain
Deceit fills the hearts that plot evil; peacemakers rejoice / No mischief comes to the righteous; the wicked brim with vice
Yahweh abhors lying lips; truthful people bring delight / The prudent guard their knowledge; fools declare what’s unwise
Diligent hands rule; the lazy toil in chains / Anxiety weighs the heart; kind words relieve its pains
The wise son listens to his father's instruction / The scoffer shuts his ears against correction
He who guards his mouth also guards his own soul / Who opens wide his lips will surely pay the toll
The sluggard desires, but has nothing to gain / The diligent's desire will be fully attained
Righteousness guards the just and keeps them upright / Wickedness overthrows the sinner outright
Some pretend they are rich, but no riches they hold / Some pretend they are poor, yet possess wealth untold
The light of the righteous it shines so brightly / The lamp of the wicked is snuffed and gives no light
Pride only breeds quarrels and sparks up a fight / Wisdom is with those who take counsel outright
A delayed hope leaves the heart sick at its core / A longing fulfilled is life’s tree evermore
The teaching of the wise is a spring, life's source / It turns one from death's snares, redirecting their course
The wicked messenger falls into distress / The trustworthy envoy brings healing, eases stress
The poor have abundant food in their fields today / Injustice sweeps their food from the fields away
A wise woman builds her house so it can stand / A foolish one tears it down with her own hands
The upright fear Yahweh, their steps are upright / The perverse despise him, their paths are not right
With no oxen, the manger stays clean and clear / The ox’s strength brings harvest and increase each year
A truthful witness saves souls and speaks no lies / The false witness speaks deceit and truth denies
The scoffer seeks wisdom, but wisdom stays closed / The discerning gain knowledge, readily disclosed
The prudent think about their way, with care in mind / The folly of fools is deceit of every kind
The heart knows its own bitterness and joy it bears inside / A stranger cannot share it, standing close beside
The wicked house will crumble, every wall will fall / The upright’s tent will flourish, growing green and tall
A way may seem right, just as the person believes / Its end is death, though the seeming deceives
Even in laughter the heart may hold sorrow within / And mirth may end in heaviness beneath a grin
The simple believe each thing they hear, and trust it all / The prudent weigh their every way before they heed the call
The fear of Yahweh stands as a fortress secure / For his children, a refuge, steadfast and sure
The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life / It turns people from death’s snares, turns them away
The poor are shunned even by their neighbor, it’s clear / Who pities the poor is blessed; the truth is clear
A heart at peace gives life to the body as a whole / But the envy rots the bones, exacting its toll
Righteousness exalts a nation, lifts it to the sky / But sin disgraces all its people, shaming them thereby
A gentle answer turns away wrath, lets anger subside / A harsh word stirs up anger, makes it quickly rise
The wise tongue commends knowledge, in words it conveys / The mouths of fools gush folly in the things they say
Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, all deeds within his view / He keeps watch on both, the evil and the good too
A gentle tongue is a tree of life, its words help life to grow / Deceit within it crushes the spirit, and lays it low
The righteous house holds much treasure; plenty is there / The wicked income brings them trouble, a weight they bear
The wicked sacrifice is loathsome in Yahweh’s sight / The upright’s prayer is pleasing, and brings him delight
Sheol and Abaddon lie open before Yahweh’s eyes / How much more the hearts of men are seen without disguise
A glad heart makes a cheerful face, its gladness plain / An aching heart breaks the spirit, weighed down by pain
The afflicted endure wretched days, each one marked by pain / A cheerful heart enjoys a feast that never wanes
Better is little with the fear of Yahweh, that's clear / Than great treasure with trouble, however riches appear
Better herbs where love is than a fattened calf’s rich meal / A fattened calf with hatred has no such appeal
A wrathful person stirs contention, starts a fight / One slow to anger appeases strife, and sets things right
The sluggard’s way is like a thorn patch, rough terrain / The upright’s path is like a highway, a clear lane
Without good counsel, plans can stumble and fail / With many counselors, their plans stand and prevail
The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom, making one wise / Humility comes before honor’s rise
Man plans within his heart; Yahweh gives the tongue its say / Yahweh directs each step he takes along the way
A man’s own ways seem clean to him; he judges them right / But Yahweh weighs his motives, hidden from his sight
Commit your deeds to Yahweh; place each purpose in his hand / Then your plans shall succeed, just as Yahweh has planned
Yahweh made everything, each for its own end / Even the wicked for the evil day, he did intend
Yahweh detests the pride that rises up in the heart / The proud will not go unpunished; judgment leaves its mark
Mercy and truth atone for sin, and cleanse each stain / Fear of Yahweh turns people from evil’s chain
When a man’s ways please Yahweh, his foes find peace with him / Kings delight in righteous lips, and value truth in them
A little with righteousness is better to attain / Great revenues through injustice do not outweigh that gain
Yahweh owns the honest scales; the weights are his alone / Yahweh abhors kings’ wrong; righteousness upholds the throne
Wisdom is better to get than gold you can buy / Choose understanding over silver; rank it high
Pride comes before destruction, before the final fall / An arrogant spirit comes before the downfall
Understanding’s a fountain of life, a living spring / Pleasant words are honeycomb, sweet, and health they bring
A worthless man’s speech burns like a scorching fire / A whisperer divides close friends; their bonds expire
The slow to anger deserves more than a victor’s crown / One who rules his own spirit surpasses the one who storms towns
The pot refines silver; gold meets the furnace flame / Yahweh tests the hearts, revealing nothing more
Whoever mocks the poor reproaches their own Maker / Glad at calamity won’t escape punishment later
Covering offense promotes love in the heart / Repeating a matter tears best friends apart
A rebuke cuts deep in the wise person’s mind / A hundred lashes reach a fool less deep inside
Better meet a bear whose cubs were taken away / Than to meet a fool with folly on display
Strife begins like breaching a dam; that’s the start / Stop all contention before quarrels can start
Yahweh abhors whoever calls the wicked right / And one who condemns the just; both offend His sight
A friend loves at all times, in ease and in strife / A brother is born for adversity in life
A cheerful heart makes good medicine, indeed / A crushed spirit will dry up the bones, indeed
Even a fool, when silent, is thought to be wise / Shut lips make him seem discerning in others’ eyes
Alone, he chases self and casts sound judgment away / The fool just airs his view, with no thought to weigh
A man’s words are deep waters, running far below / Wisdom’s fountain flows like a brook, its waters flow
Gossip’s words are dainty morsels people eat / They sink into the innermost parts, running deep
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower; the righteous run safe inside / The rich man thinks his wealth a wall no force can divide
Before destruction, the heart of man is proud / Before honor, humility is what is found
He answers before he hears, and folly marks his word / That brings him shame, as the proverb has declared
A man’s spirit sustains him in sickness, helping him stand / But who can bear a crushed spirit, bent under its hand?
The first to plead seems right till the questions start / The lot settles disputes, keeps strong rivals apart
A brother offended is harder than a fortified wall / Disputes are like the bars of a fortress, built tall
Death and life lie in the tongue; its power runs deep / Those who love it eat the fruit their words will reap
Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, Yahweh’s favor found / There is a friend who sticks closer than a brother, firmly bound
The poor who walk upright are better than the fools / The one whose lips are perverse is truly a fool
Zeal without knowledge is not good; it leads you wrong / Hasty feet miss the way as they rush along
A fool’s own foolishness, it subverts his way / Yet in his heart, the fool rages against Yahweh
Wealth adds many friends who gather at your side / The poor is parted from his friend; he’s cast aside
